article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever is spreading rapidly; you should also know the symptoms and prevention.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 September 2026, dengue fever is spreading rapidly across several Indian states, with Delhi reporting a concerning rise in cases. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes after biting an infected person; it does not spread person-to-person. Four dengue virus serotypes (DEN-1 to DEN-4) mean a person can be infected by different strains over time. Mosquitoes bite most during midday—about two hours after sunrise and one hour before sunset—and can bite at night in indoor areas with artificial lighting, increasing risk in offices, malls, indoor auditoriums, and stadiums. Symptoms typically appear 4–6 days after infection and last about 10 days: sudden high fever, severe headache, pain behind the eyes, joint and muscle pains, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, red rash, and mild bleeding. Prevention focuses on daytime protection (long sleeves, skin coverage, footwear), eliminating standing water around homes, and using mosquito nets at night.

article.articleHeadline: RIPK2 Inhibitor GSK583 Curbss H1N1 Flu Replication and Tames Lung
article.articleSummary: Influenza A/H1N1 PR8 (A/Puerto Rico/8/1934) replication was curtailed by RIPK2 inhibitor GSK583 in vitro and in a mouse infection model conducted by teams at the University of Science and Technology of China and Huazhong University of Science and Technology. In cell culture, GSK583 reduced viral RNA and viral protein, and supernatants yielded far fewer plaque-forming units, indicating suppression of virion release rather than direct inactivation or receptor-blocking. Time-of-addition experiments showed activity only after adsorption, consistent with post-entry effects or host signaling. In mice treated early after infection, disease severity was alleviated, pulmonary viral RNA and nucleoprotein were reduced, and lung inflammation declined, signaling lower replication and tissue damage. Mechanistically, the RIPK2–MKK7–JNK axis underlies the effect: RIPK2–MKK7 interaction and JNK phosphorylation tracked with replication, and genetic or pharmacologic disruption of this axis corroborated the findings. This host-directed approach could broaden influenza therapeutics and reduce severe lung injury.

article.articleHeadline: Mycoplasma Leads Pediatric Respiratory Infections in Post-COVID China,
article.articleSummary: In Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, China, a retrospective analysis of 34,404 pediatric patients with respiratory symptoms (Jan 2023–Dec 2024) found Mycoplasma pneumoniae as the leading positive pathogen at 26.94%, making it the top cause of pediatric respiratory infections. Throat swabs were tested with multiplex PCR for 13 viral and atypical bacterial pathogens, yielding an overall positivity rate of 69.14%. Rhinovirus was second (16.29%), adenovirus third (9.00%). Coinfections occurred in 19.85% of positive samples, with dual infections most common. Seasonal variation was evident over the two-year period, highlighting rebound patterns after COVID-19 restrictions eased. Mycoplasma pneumoniae, an atypical bacterium lacking a cell wall, does not respond to beta-lactams, underscoring implications for treatment decisions. Findings from the Affiliated Women and Children’s Hospital of Ningbo University and published in BMC Infectious Diseases provide an epidemiological reference for post-COVID pediatric respiratory care and testing strategies.

article.articleHeadline: Gejala Super Flu yang Dikira Covid-19, di Sumut Ada 3 Kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Symptoms of Super Flu Mistaken for COVID-19 in North Sumatra: 3 Cases.
article.articleSummary: Three cases of a rapidly spreading influenza A (H3N2) subclade K, described as 'super flu,' are confirmed in North Sumatra, Indonesia, per the Ministry of Health’s Influenza and COVID-19 Case Surveillance Report through 19 September 2026 (week 37). Jawa Timur (East Java) and Kalimantan Selatan (South Kalimantan) report a higher total of 18 cases, indicating broader circulation. Health authorities emphasize that 'super flu' is not an official medical term; it denotes ISPA caused by influenza A H3N2 with mutations that may erode protection from standard vaccines and accelerate transmission. Symptoms include severe cough, sore throat, nasal congestion, muscle aches, headache, and extreme fatigue appearing 3–4 days after exposure, often mistaken for COVID-19. Contextual history cites mid-2025 activity in the UK, Japan, and the US, with New York reaching about 71,000 weekly cases at a mutation-driven peak.

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's Ebola Outbreak Spreads to Two New Health Zones, WHO Reports
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak expands with 27 new cases, bringing 63 affected health zones across seven provinces. The Bundibugyo strain is confirmed in two new regions: Bulu (South Ubangi, bordering the Central African Republic) and Dungu (Haut-Uele, bordering South Sudan). Ituri remains the epicenter with 6,032 confirmed since May; North Kivu reports 1,480 new cases, including 567 in the last 21 days, about one third of recent cases and deaths. North Kivu’s case fatality approaches 60%, above the national average of 48%. Access remains hampered by conflict and population displacement, complicating case finding and contact tracing; only about 30,000 of an estimated 420,000 contacts are on the list from over 7,000 confirmed cases. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines; WHO accelerates vaccine and treatment trials and stresses rigorous contact tracing and early identification. Some patients delay seeking care, worsening outbreak control.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Special Mid-Autumn Festival Gift for Vietnamese Children: The Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease Vaccine Now Available at VNVC, Vaccinate Children from 2 Months of Age.
article.articleSummary: EV71-based hand, foot, and mouth disease vaccine launched at VNVC in Vietnam, for children from 2 months to under 6 years, with a 2–3 dose schedule. Leading pediatric infectious disease expert Dr. Trương Hữu Khanh notes EV71-driven HFMD can rapidly progress to severe neurological and cardiopulmonary complications, with CNS injury most likely in the brainstem, hypothalamus, and cerebellum, and some cases turning critical within 6–8 hours. Phase III trials in Vietnam showed 96.8% protection against EV71-related HFMD, with no EV71 cases among vaccinated children and immunity across multiple EV71 genotypes. VNVC has prepared supply chains, cold chain, and trained staff to roll out protection nationwide, across nearly 300 VNVC centers. On 25 September 2026, tens of thousands registered and began vaccination, including at VNVC Cai Lậy, Tiền Giang. This Mid-Autumn Festival gift aims to shield Vietnamese children during the high season.

article.articleHeadline: Gut Microbe's Acetate Signal Calms Deadly Diarrhea in Newborn Calves
article.articleSummary: Published in Microbiome on 2026-09-26, Huazhong Agricultural University researchers trace a microbiota–metabolite–immune axis in neonatal calf diarrhea. Diarrheic newborn calves show gut dysbiosis, metabolic perturbation, and inflammatory activation. Fecal microbiota transplantation from healthy calves alleviates diarrhea and coincides with enrichment of Bifidobacterium pseudocatenulatum and higher fecal acetate. In vitro, live B. pseudocatenulatum increases acetate production, suggesting a causal bacterium–metabolite link. In murine models mimicking calf intestinal injury, treatment with live B. pseudocatenulatum or acetate reduces intestinal damage and pathogen-driven Th17/IL-17A responses; heat-killed bacteria lose protection, implicating microbial metabolism. Acetate signals via FFAR2, and FFAR2 blockade attenuates protection. These findings define a targetable microbiota–metabolite–immune pathway with potential probiotic or metabolite-based interventions for neonatal calf diarrhea.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 65 Influenza A Cases Detected in Bandung, Public Urged Not to Panic.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 September 2026, Bandung, West Java reports 65 laboratory-confirmed Influenza A cases from swab tests. Health official Raden Vini Adiani Dewi urges calm, noting Influenza A is highly transmissible and can produce more severe symptoms than ordinary flu. Common signs include headache, high fever, body aches, and fatigue. The public should monitor for three days after onset; if symptoms persist or worsen, seek care promptly. Testing for Influenza A is not available everywhere, and whole genome sequencing is limited to select labs, including the West Java Provincial Health Laboratory. No deaths related to Influenza A have been reported in Bandung.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rain-induced waterlogging has worsened the problem; 47 dengue patients were detected in Varanasi; the department wrote a letter to the Municipal Corporation | Varanasi Dengue Cases Waterlogging Malaria Chikungunya
article.articleSummary: Varanasi, 26 September 2026: rain-induced waterlogging has escalated mosquito-borne disease. Dengue: 47 cases; malaria: 7; chikungunya: 4. Aedes and Anopheles larvae breed in clogged coolers, pots, old tires, buckets, and other standing water across wards. The Malaria Department has written to the Municipal Corporation urging intensified anti-larva spraying, fogging, and sanitation drives. At Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya District Hospital's Doctors Colony, waterlogging worsens conditions for residents and health workers. The Chief Medical Officer urges residents to eliminate standing water, refresh cooler water weekly, cover containers, and remove water from tires and pot bases. Use mosquito nets and wear full-body clothing at night. Seek prompt testing for fever, joint or head pains at nearby health facilities.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A study on dengue prevention and awareness activities in Vallam Town Panchayat near Thanjavur.
article.articleSummary: In Vallam Town Panchayat near Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu, dengue prevention and awareness activities were conducted under Field Officer Rajasekharan. Inspecting all wards, health authorities identified mosquito breeding risks in homes and surrounding areas and instructed residents to prevent water stagnation. With seasonal rains causing standing water in residential areas, Aedes mosquitoes can thrive even in small water collections. Residents were advised to remove discarded items likely to hold rainwater - old drums, plastic containers, tires, and coconut shells - and to cover stored drinking water and any other water containers. Regular maintenance of roof and ground-level tanks was urged, along with keeping yards and public spaces free of standing water. Authorities emphasized weekly cleanliness and educated the public on dengue prevention; fever symptoms should prompt immediate visit to government hospitals or health facilities.

article.articleHeadline: Fiebre aftosa: APPEC advierte sobre el riesgo económico para las exportaciones de carne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foot-and-mouth disease: APPEC warns about the economic risk to meat exports.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), especially serotype SAT 1, is framed by Paraguay’s APPEC as an economic threat to meat exports as SAT 1 spreads beyond its historical range. The World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) monitors SAT 1 incursions in Africa, Europe, the Middle East and Asia, signaling risks to animal health, livelihoods, food security and international trade. Economic losses can reach about 1% of GDP in small cattle-dependent economies, with trade disruptions potentially matching or exceeding direct production losses. In Paraguay, beef exports through August 2026 totaled 186,175 tonnes worth US$1.299 billion, down 25% in volume versus 2025, while the average price rose to US$7,410/ton. Main destinations included Chile (20,609 t, US$399 million), followed by Israel, the United States, Taiwan and Brazil. APPEC calls for stronger vaccination and epidemiological surveillance; WOAH emphasizes vaccination, biosecurity, movement controls, border surveillance and early warning systems. Paraguay also pursued new markets, such as beef shipments to the UAE and veterinary audits for Turkey.

article.articleHeadline: Новый китайский вирус? Правда об ALTNV и симптомы инфекции
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Chinese Virus? The Truth About ALTNV and the Symptoms of Infection.
article.articleSummary: ALTNV is not a new pathogen; it is a tick-borne virus in the Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever group, identified through advanced genetic analysis in China. In Russia, there are no officially reported human cases; transmission occurs only via tick bites, specifically the Asian long-horned tick, found in the Far East (Primorsky Krai and southern Khabarovsk Krai), with European Russia unlikely to host this vector. Symptoms resemble other acute tick-borne infections: abrupt fever, chills, severe headache, myalgia, sometimes nausea or diarrhea; labs show thrombocytopenia, leukopenia, and elevated liver enzymes, with potential bleeding or petechiae in severe thrombocytopenia. The 18% mortality figure is overstated and applies only to patients with co-infections; isolated ALTNV infections are typically moderate with no deaths. No vaccine or specific therapy exists; prevention relies on repellents, light-colored closed clothing, and thorough body checks after outdoor activity. In Kuban (Krasnodar region), 2026 tick bites total 3,574 (1,365 children), down 10.5% vs 2025; Krasnodar city accounts for 683 cases (231 children); last week, 21 cases. Surveillance of ~11,000 ticks found 17.2% positive for Lyme borreliosis among 2,802 tested.

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola tại CHDC Congo lan sang hai khu vực mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo spreads to two new regions.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to two additional health zones, Bulu in Sud-Ubangi and Dungu in Haut-Uele, bringing the outbreak to 63 health zones across 7 provinces. As of Sept 23, 2026, Congo has 7,890 confirmed infections and 3,799 deaths. WHO warns that conflict and population displacement hinder access to affected communities and contact tracing, while the absence of vaccines and licensed treatments for Bundibugy o complicates response and may deter care-seeking. Authorities are expediting clinical trials for vaccines and treatments. The outbreak is crossing borders, with Ubangi River linking areas toward Kinshasa; monitoring is active for neighboring South Sudan, Central African Republic, and Uganda-border regions. Ten countries are deemed high risk, with preparedness efforts underway. Japan has announced urgent aid to assist Congo's Ebola response.

triage.notes: 南スーダン・中央アフリカ共和国・ウガンダ国境地域は監視対象として言及されているのみで、実際の症例発生は確認されていないため verified_locations には含めていない。日本は支援国として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A dan ISPA Merebak, Rumah Sakit di Jatim Diminta Waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A and ARI Are Spreading, Hospitals in East Java Urged to Be Vigilant
article.articleSummary: Influenza A and acute respiratory infection (ARI) continue to fluctuate in East Java, Indonesia. The Jawa Timur provincial government reports declines in some facilities, notably at Kedungkandang Public Health Center in Malang City, but increases persist in other districts, keeping surveillance ongoing. Influenza is generally self-limiting, yet clinicians are advised to monitor patients closely, especially when immunity is reduced or when complications or comorbid conditions are present. Hospitals should not underestimate patients presenting with flu-like symptoms and should tailor care, including outpatient management or higher-level referrals as needed. No East Java hospital has reported being overwhelmed or turning patients away due to Influenza A to date. Authorities will continually monitor case counts and facility capacity and urge reporting of any service-delivery obstacles.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAおよびARIが拡大、東ジャワの病院に警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の変動範囲内であり、医療機関の逼迫や重症化の急増は報告されていないため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 地方保健当局が監視を継続している通常の季節性インフルエンザ報道であり、病院の対応能力超過や重症例急増の報告はない。特定地域（東ジャワ）のみの事象であり、対象国リストの中ではインドネシアだが、事象の性質上シグナルには該当しないと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza di Depok Melonjak hingga 90 Persen, Anak dan Lansia Paling Banyak Terinfeksi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza cases in Depok rise by as much as 90 percent, with children and the elderly most affected.
article.articleSummary: Influenza cases in Depok, West Java, rise with a 90% laboratory-confirmed positivity rate over the past four weeks, increasing from 140 to 266 cases as of 25 September 2026, according to Depok Health Office data. Disease is caused by influenza A and B viruses. The surge affects primarily children under five and the elderly, but also individuals with chronic conditions or compromised immunity. Reported influenza symptoms include fever or chills, cough, sore throat, runny or congested nose, muscle or body aches, headache, and fatigue. Health official Devi Mayori emphasizes vigilance without overreaction, urging simple risk-mitigation measures: healthy lifestyle, cough and sneeze etiquette, regular handwashing, avoiding close contact with influenza patients, and masking when sick. Vaccination against influenza is recommended for vulnerable groups to reduce complications.

triage.headline_ja: デポック市でインフルエンザ症例が90%急増、子供と高齢者に最も多く感染
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の増加パターンであり、IHR基準の該当は少ないが、地域での症例急増のため経過観察対象とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA/Bによる地域的な症例増加。保健当局は既に対応中で、過度な懸念は不要としている。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：刚果（金）埃博拉疫情扩散至新地区
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to new areas.
article.articleSummary: The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola has spread to new areas in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 7 provinces and 63 health zones reporting cases. As of September 23, 2026, the DRC has 7,890 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 3,799 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that conflict and population displacement hinder access for health workers and complicate contact tracing, raising transmission risk. Africa CDC head Jean Kaseya estimated about 60 direct or indirect contacts per case; by that rate, tracing should cover over 400,000 people, yet only around 30,000 contact names have been identified, and more than 80% of new confirmed cases are not on contact lists. Tedros noted there is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola virus, making the response harder and potentially deterring people from seeking care at treatment centers.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行が新たな地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が7州63保健地域に拡大し、死者3,799人・確認症例7,890人に達し、承認されたワクチン・治療法もないためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 紛争と住民避難により接触者追跡が困難で、新規確認症例の80%以上が接触者リストに未登録。承認されたワクチン・治療薬がなく、対応が一層困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: കേരളം നേരിടുന്ന ഏറ്റവും ഗുരുതര പ്രശ്നമായി തെരുവുനായ ശല്യം മാറി. ഇക്കൊല്ലം ഇതുവരെ കടിയേറ്റത് 2.18 ലക്ഷം പേർക്ക്. പേവിഷബാധ മൂലം14 മരണങ്ങൾ. അപകടങ്ങളിൽ പരിക്കേൽക്കുന്നവരും നിരവധി. ഏറ്റവും മരണങ്ങൾ കൊല്ലത്തും തിരുവനന്തപുരത്തും. ദയാവധം തീരുമാനിച്ചെങ്കിലും നടപ്പാക്കാനായില്ല. വന്ധ്യകരണം, വാക്സിനേഷൻ, ഷെൽട്ടർ എന്നിവയൊന്നും ഫലപ്രദമല്ല. വാക്സിനേഷന് തദ്ദേശസ്ഥാപനങ്ങൾ ചെലവിട്ടത് 18കോടി. സർക്കാരും തദ്ദേശ സ്ഥാപനങ്ങളും ഒത്തുപിടിച്ച് തെരുവുനായ ശല്യം തീർക്കുമോ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kerala's street dog menace has become the state's most serious problem. So far, 2.18 lakh people have been bitten. 14 deaths due to rabies. Many are injured in incidents. Most deaths have occurred in Kollam and Thiruvananthapuram. Although a humane decision was taken, it could not be implemented. Sterilization, vaccination, and shelters are not effective. Local authorities spent 18 crore on vaccination. Will the government and local bodies come together to end the street dog menace?
article.articleSummary: Kerala's street-dog menace is the state's most serious public-health challenge, with 2.18 lakh people bitten and 14 rabies deaths. Kollam district reports the most rabies deaths (four), followed by Thiruvananthapuram (three); the issue is pervasive across urban and rural areas. Despite Supreme Court directions to move street dogs from public spaces, shelters and related measures remain inadequate; sterilization, vaccination, and shelters have not been effective. A humane euthanasia policy for rabies-positive or aggressive dogs was approved but not implemented. Local bodies have allocated about 18 crore for vaccination, yet execution has been poor. Implementing humane measures requires ABC centers, trained dog-handlers, and transport facilities. The state needs forest-adjacent shelter land and an integrated, long-term program—eight to ten years of sustained ABC and mass vaccination, plus improved waste management, responsible pet ownership, and wildlife monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州で野良犬による咬傷が深刻化、今年だけで21.8万人が被害・狂犬病で14人死亡。安楽死方針は未実施、対策の効果乏しく地方自治体はワクチン接種に1.8億ルピーを投入
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準は1つのみ該当だが、WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度・曝露継続・流行しやすさ・管理可能性の複数項目に該当し、加えて地元メディアでの高い社会的関心が確認されるためフルRRAへの移行を検討すべき。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はインドで地方流行病であり新規性は低いが、咬傷件数・死亡数の規模、対策（不妊手術・ワクチン接種・シェルター）の実効性欠如、安楽死方針未実施など、州レベルの公衆衛生課題として継続的な監視が必要。国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Deteksi Dini Penyakit Menular, Rutan Balikpapan Gelar Skrining Kesehatan Warga Binaan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early Detection of Infectious Diseases, Balikpapan Detention Center Holds Health Screening for Inmates
article.articleSummary: On 26 September 2026, Balikpapan Class IIA Detention Center conducted health screening for inmates, in collaboration with the Balikpapan City Health Office via Gunung Samarinda and Baru Tengah Health Centers. Health teams from both centers, together with Rutan Balikpapan's Clinic staff, carried out early-detection checks to identify health conditions and enable timely follow-up when risks are found. In addition to screening, inmates received education on HIV and tuberculosis, covering transmission, prevention, risk factors, and the importance of regular health examinations. The initiative emphasizes hygiene, clean environments, and shared awareness to prevent infectious disease spread within the facility. Rutan Head Andre Silalahi stressed ongoing collaboration with health authorities to guarantee nondiscriminatory access to healthcare, aiming for a healthy, safe, humane prison environment and prompt medical care.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症の早期発見、バリクパパン拘置所が収監者向け健康スクリーニングを実施
triage.triage_reason: 定期的な健康スクリーニングと教育活動であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、拘置所内でのHIV・結核の予防的スクリーニングおよび啓発活動に関するもの。

article.articleHeadline: 全球公衛焦點掃描：剛果伊波拉疫情擴散與新藥研發動態 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global Public Health Focus Scan: Ebola Outbreak in Congo Spreads and Updates on New Drug Development - Formosa TV News Network
article.articleSummary: As of 26 September 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo virus, continues to spread, now reaching two additional health zones and expanding across seven provinces and 63 districts. A confirmed mpox (monkeypox) case was also reported in Bunia, a city in the northeast, placing further strain on local health systems already engaged in Ebola response. The dual public health challenges underscore sustained transmission and the importance of reinforced surveillance, rapid case finding, isolation, and contact tracing in affected areas. Ongoing updates indicate the outbreak remains active in multiple jurisdictions, with cross-regional spread requiring coordinated district- and province-level interventions.

triage.headline_ja: 世界公衆衛生フォーカススキャン：コンゴのエボラ疫病拡大と新薬開発動向
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）がDRCで7州63地区に拡大しており、さらにMpox症例も報告され医療体制に負荷がかかっているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: エボラの原因ウイルスはBundibugyo virus（Ebola Bundibugyoウイルス）であり、複数州・地区に拡大中。Mpox症例はBunia市で確認され、既存のエボラ対応と重複して医療資源への負担が増大している。

article.articleHeadline: आलेख : डेंगू वैक्सीन, बीमारी के खिलाफ नई उम्मीद
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Editorial: Dengue vaccine, new hope against the disease.
article.articleSummary: Dengue remains a major public health challenge in India, with seasonal outbreaks across urban and rural areas driven by climate variability, urbanization, water stagnation, and mosquito breeding. Takeda's Qdenga dengue vaccine, in partnership with Hyderabad-based Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, will be promoted and distributed in the private Indian market, with a potential launch in the first half of 2027 pending local regulatory and commercial clearances; price details are not yet disclosed. Public affordability and broad access are key, as dengue affects not only megacities but smaller towns and rural communities. A long-term goal is to include Qdenga in India's public vaccination program, subject to disease burden, efficacy, safety, age groups, cost-effectiveness, and health-system impact. The rollout also aims to raise dengue awareness and engage health professionals; vaccination should complement, not replace, fundamental control measures such as vector control, sanitation, timely diagnosis, and proper treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 社説：デング熱ワクチン、病気に対する新たな希望
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱ワクチン（Qdenga）の商業展開に関する社説・解説記事であり、具体的な発生急増や異常事態を報告するものではないため。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の季節的流行を背景とした一般的な公衆衛生課題とワクチン導入計画についての解説であり、特定の異常発生や急増を報告するものではない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Jabar Deteksi 65 Kasus Influenza A atau Flu Babi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Java Health Department Detects 65 Cases of Influenza A or Swine Flu.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A (H1N1) detected: 65 laboratory-confirmed cases in Bandung City, West Java, Indonesia, based on whole-genome sequencing at Labkes Jabar. The figure reflects patients who consented to swab testing and WGS; real numbers are likely higher due to limited testing facilities in districts and cost-related reluctance to use private clinics. Influenza A is described as highly transmissible and capable of causing more severe symptoms than seasonal flu, including headache, high fever, muscle pains, and weakness, contributing to increased hospital occupancy in Bandung. Findings underscore ongoing local surveillance as of 26 September 2026. The article does not specify infection sources or exported/imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 西ジャワ保健局、インフルエンザA(豚インフルエンザ)65例を検出
triage.triage_reason: 西ジャワ州バンドンでインフルエンザA(H1N1)65例が確認され病院占有率上昇との報告があるが、感染源・輸出入例・重症度の詳細情報が不足しており、既知の季節性株である可能性が高いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: H1N1は2009年パンデミック由来で現在は季節性インフルエンザとして流通しているため、既存の季節性流行の可能性が高い。実数は検査体制の限界からさらに多い可能性があると記事内で言及。続報を要監視。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Cases Rising In Delhi: These 4 Foods Can Support Recovery, Know What To Eat For Fast Recovery
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases are rising in Delhi, with 432 cases detected in September 2026. Dengue, a dangerous fever spread mainly by infected female Aedes mosquitoes, can cause platelet depletion and may be fatal without timely treatment. Symptoms include sudden high fever, headache, and severe muscle pain. There is no specific antiviral treatment; management focuses on fever and pain, with ongoing medical care. The article highlights four foods that may support recovery but are not a substitute for medical treatment: goat’s milk (easy to digest and contains selenium), papaya leaf juice (antioxidants and enzymes such as papain and chymopapain that may boost immunity and platelets), coconut water (rehydration and energy), and kiwi (vitamins C and E, antioxidants, and potassium). Emphasizes continuing prescribed medications and consulting a doctor if symptoms persist. A disclaimer notes information is from various sources and not an endorsement by ABP News.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでデング熱の症例が増加：回復を助ける4つの食品とは
triage.triage_reason: デリーでのデング熱症例増加（2026年9月に432件）は季節性流行の範囲内とみられ、健康情報記事であるため社会的関心の高さは限定的だが、症例数の推移は経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の栄養面での対処法を紹介する健康情報記事であり、感染拡大の詳細（重症度、死亡者数、対策状況）は記載されていない。デリーは毎年デング熱流行地域であり、今回の432件が異常な増加かどうかは不明。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：刚果（金）埃博拉疫情扩散至新地区
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to new areas.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak of Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to new areas, with 63 health zones across 7 provinces reporting cases. As of September 23, 2026, the country has 7,890 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 3,799 deaths. Ongoing conflict and population displacement hinder access for health workers and complicate contact tracing, elevating transmission risk. The Africa CDC director notes that each confirmed case may have about 60 direct or indirect contacts, implying contact-tracing coverage should exceed 400,000, yet only about 30,000 contacts have been traced, and over 80% of new cases are not on contact lists. Despite improvements in case detection, safe burial practices, and community engagement, the Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or approved therapy, making response more challenging and potentially discouraging people from seeking care at treatment centers.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、新たな地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCの63保健地区・7州に拡大し、7,890例・3,799死亡と甚大な公衆衛生影響があり、ワクチン・治療薬未承認かつ紛争による接触者追跡困難でヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスにはライセンス済みワクチン・承認治療薬がなく、接触者追跡率が著しく低い（目標40万人に対し実績約3万人）ため、感染拡大の継続リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: 网传日本梅毒"大暴发"引关注 狮城政府：新加坡发病率连3年下降 - 地方 - 狮城二三事
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Online reports of a 'massive outbreak' of syphilis in Japan draw attention; Lion City government: Singapore's incidence rate has fallen for three consecutive years - Local - Lion City: Two or Three Things
article.articleSummary: Syphilis remains a public health concern across Asia. In Japan, official data show cases peaked around 15,000 in 2023 and have since declined; however, a shortage of Pfizer’s long-acting benzathine penicillin is expected to persist until the second half of next year. Singapore reports a three-year decline in syphilis incidence, from 129 per 100,000 in 2022 to 107 (2023), 86 (2024), and 84 (2025), with benzathine penicillin supplies currently sufficient. The infection is mainly transmitted via unprotected sex, blood, and mother-to-child transmission, not casual contact. In Mainland China, first-half-year cases exceed 334,000, up 3.8% year-on-year; Taiwan, about 6,900 in eight months. Thailand rose from 8,737 (2022) to over 25,000 (2024). Hong Kong reported 926 in 2024 (down from 824). Korea declined from 2,790 (2024) to 2,211 (2023). Public health measures emphasize testing and partner notification.

triage.headline_ja: ネットで話題の日本の梅毒「大流行」に注目集まる、シンガポール政府「発病率は3年連続で低下」
triage.triage_reason: 梅毒はアジア各国で慢性的な公衆衛生課題として報告されているが、急性の異常事態や新規アウトブレイクではなく、既知の性感染症の統計的推移を報じる内容であるため、フルRRAではなく経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は日本・シンガポール・中国本土・台湾・タイ・香港・韓国の梅毒統計を横断的に比較する内容。対象国リストのうち、記事で具体的な統計が言及されているのは中国本土とタイのみ（日本・韓国・台湾・香港・シンガポールは対象国リスト外）。ベンザチンペニシリン供給不足という薬剤供給問題が背景にある点は留意すべき。

article.articleHeadline: L'Ebola senza vaccino avanza in Congo e arriva ai confini con Centrafrica e Sud Sudan: 3.799 morti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola without a vaccine advances in the Congo and reaches the borders with Central African Republic and South Sudan: 3,799 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus Bundibugyo strain is advancing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, reaching border zones Bulu (Sud Ubangi) toward Central African Republic and Dungu (Haut-Uélé) toward South Sudan. As of Sept 23, 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths (case fatality 48.1%). Ituri remains the epicenter with 6,032 cases, 868 in the last 21 days; cross-border transmission risk is rising. There is no approved vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo. Merck’s Ervebo vaccine, effective against Zaire ebolavirus, is being trialed in Ituri since Sept 21 with 20,000 doses allocated for health workers and response teams (out of 70,000 available). Tracing is weak: about 30,000 contacts identified vs >400,000 expected. International funding: G20 pledges $2.9B; the US adds $267M, bringing its total to $887M for treatment centers, safe burials, PPE, and surveillance. Spillover May 14, 2026; outbreak May 15; by August, it was described as the second-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンなきエボラ出血熱、コンゴで拡大し中央アフリカ共和国・南スーダン国境に到達：死者3,799人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）し、致死率48%・ワクチン未承認・国境地域への拡大という重大なアウトブレイクであるため、フルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株のエボラで承認ワクチン・治療法なし。接触者追跡は目標の1割未満(約3万人 vs 40万人超)と極めて不十分。中央アフリカ共和国・南スーダンへの越境リスクは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めていないが、リスク評価上は重要な要素。G20が29億ドル、米国が8.87億ドルを拠出するなど国際的な資金投入が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: PondiCM inaugurates conclave on advanced genomic diagnostics for TB
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-26, Puducherry Chief Minister N. Rangasamy inaugurated a three-day National Conclave on Advanced Genomic Diagnostics for Tuberculosis and Policy Dialogue on Universal Drug Susceptibility Testing (UDST) using Targeted Next-Generation Sequencing (TNGS) for TB, organized by JIPMER. The national programme brought together policymakers, public health experts, clinicians, researchers and genomic scientists to deliberate on strengthening drug-resistance detection and advancing genomic technologies for TB diagnosis and treatment. The initiative focuses on scaling UDST through targeted sequencing to rapidly identify drug-resistant TB strains and guide therapy. Rangasamy stated that the Puducherry Government, in collaboration with the Centre, is undertaking several measures toward TB elimination. The conclave highlights the integration of advanced genomics into TB control efforts and reinforces policy dialogue and investment in diagnostics and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ポンディシェリ首席大臣、結核の高度ゲノム診断に関する会議を開幕
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核の高度ゲノム診断・政策会議に関する報道であり、新規の異常発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 会議・政策対話に関する記事であり、感染症の新規発生や急増を報告するものではないため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : les mesures de prévention renforcées dans les écoles
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: strengthened preventive measures in schools
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri province sees strengthened school-based prevention and control measures. In the Rwampara health zone, schools are now equipped with infection prevention and control materials, with school brigades and focal points established to supervise surveillance and liaise with health teams. Health authorities, led by Dr. Patrick Basara, conduct daily visits to schools to screen for fever; any student with elevated temperature is immediately isolated. Surveillance around students exposed to a confirmed case is intensified; at Maranata School in Shari, a positive case has been detected, with pupils followed up through community relay volunteers, each monitoring about twenty students, plus home surveillance for households of involved children. If signs appear, patients are routed to the CT (Centre de Traitement) to cut transmission chains. In Lalia Primary School near Biakato-centre, Mambasa territory, concern follows the Wednesday Ebola death of a student, with some pupils leaving class and parents delaying attendance. Authorities urge strict adherence to prevention measures to reduce school-based transmission.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州でのエボラ出血熱：学校における予防対策強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州で学校関連のエボラ症例・死亡が確認されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCイツリ州（Mambasa地域含む）の学校を中心としたエボラ対応に関するもの。Rwanda（Kigali Province）は発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文中で発生国として言及されておらず除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Campak Manokwari Meningkat, Dinkes Gelar Imunisasi Tambahan secara Massal Oktober 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases in Manokwari rise; Health Office to conduct mass supplementary immunization in October 2026.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in Manokwari, West Papua, have prompted a rapid public health response. Through mid-September 2026, 70 suspected measles cases were recorded across eight Puskesmas jurisdictions, with three laboratory-confirmed positives at Wosi, Sanggeng, and Pasir Putih clinics. Of the suspects, 47 cases (67%) are under five years old, and 49 cases (70%) lack immunization evidence, indicating gaps in vaccination coverage. Thirty-four patients (49%) required hospitalization at RSUD Manokwari or RSUP, though the Case Fatality Rate stands at 0%. A cluster in Kampung Susweni (Amban Puskesmas) yielded 13 cases within 20 days, signaling active household transmission. Epidemiologists note that Manokwari meets the criteria for a public health emergency (KLB) with 28 cases from weeks 31–36. Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) for Measles-Rubella will run for 12 working days, Oct 5–17, 2026, targeting 9 months to under 5 years with at least 95% coverage, preceded by socialization Sept 28–Oct 3.

triage.headline_ja: マノクワリの麻疹症例が増加、保健局が2026年10月に大規模追加予防接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: 西パプア州マノクワリで麻疹の集団発生（KLBと認定）があり、ワクチン未接種率が高く5歳未満児中心に多数入院。地域保健当局が緊急予防接種キャンペーンを実施予定であり、社会的・行政的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 地域限定の麻疹アウトブレイクだが、保健当局がKLB（公衆衛生緊急事態）と認定し大規模追加予防接種（ORI）を実施予定。CFRは0%で国際的拡大の兆候はないが、ワクチン未接種率の高さと家庭内感染クラスターの存在から今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 6 người tử vong vì bệnh dại, hơn 101.000 người bị chó mèo cào, cắn ở TP.HCM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six people died of rabies, more than 101,000 people have been bitten or scratched by dogs and cats in Ho Chi Minh City.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, remains a grave public health issue. As of September 26, 2026, over 101,384 people have been bitten or scratched by dogs, cats, or other pets since the start of 2026, up 11.2% year on year. Six people have died of rabies in TP.HCM this year, up two from 2025, with fatalities reported in Cu Chi, Hoa Hiep, and Long Hai communes. All deaths occurred in individuals who did not receive post-exposure vaccination or rabies immunoglobulin; factors include underestimating risk, minor wounds, or reliance on traditional remedies. Long Hai reported 128 suspected bites from dogs. There are 202 vaccination sites for rabies prophylaxis in the city (53 public, plus 18 immunoglobulin sites). Authorities urge annual pet vaccination, keeping dogs leashed, and prompt wound washing with soap and medical care after bites. World Rabies Day activities were held in Long Hai on Aug 28, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市で狂犬病により6人死亡、10万1000人以上が犬猫に噛まれる・引っかかれる被害
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ホーチミン市における狂犬病死亡例と咬傷被害の増加が報告されているが、同国では狂犬病は既知の風土病であり、異常性や国際拡大リスクは認められないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムで風土病化しており、本記事は年次の被害統計報告に近い。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、地方自治体による予防接種体制も整備されているため国際支援の必要性は低い。中国（Henan Sheng）は記事内容と無関係のためverified_locationsから除外。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A

article.articleHeadline: পুজোর আনন্দে যেন অসুখের ছায়া না পড়ে, মরসুম বদলে কোন কোন সংক্রামক রোগ নিয়ে সতর্ক হতে হবে
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: May the joy of Puja be free from the shadow of illness; which infectious diseases should we be wary of as the season changes.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 September 2026, Puja in West Bengal sees dengue cases exceeding 5,000 and rising malaria due to heavy rains and standing water that boost Aedes and Anopheles. Dengue virus is evolving with multi-organ involvement and bleeding risks; severe malaria can cause cerebral complications. Influenza remains prominent this season, with swine flu outbreaks nationwide and activity of Influenza D; rapid viral mutation complicates vaccines and treatments. Adenovirus and rhinovirus are highly contagious, even more than some coronaviruses. Waterborne hepatitis A and E spread from contaminated rainwater; unsafe street drinks and open foods heighten liver injury risk. Precautions include mosquito control; masks in crowds; hand hygiene; avoid unboiled water and street beverages; fever lasting more than 3 days or with rash, eye pain, or convulsions warrants testing; use paracetamol for fever and avoid antibiotics unless prescribed.

triage.headline_ja: プジョーの喜びに病の影が差さないように――季節の変わり目に警戒すべき感染症とは
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州で季節性のデング熱・マラリア・インフルエンザ等が例年通り増加している一般的な健康啓発記事であり、突発的な異常事態や国際的拡大の兆候はないが、季節性感染症の継続的動向として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性の健康啓発記事で、複数疾患（デング熱、マラリア、インフルエンザ、豚インフルエンザ、A型肝炎等）を包括的に扱っており、特定の突発的アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。デング熱症例数（5,000件超）の増加は言及されているが、例年の季節変動の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ca tử vong do bệnh dại ở TP.HCM tăng, áp lực phơi nhiễm trong cộng đồng ở mức cao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies-Related Deaths in Ho Chi Minh City Rise; Community Exposure Risk Remains High.
article.articleSummary: Rabies deaths in Ho Chi Minh City rise to six in 2026 (as of 26 September), up 2 from 2025, with fatalities in Cu Chi, Hoa Hiep, and Long Hai communes. Community exposure risk remains high as hospitals report 101,384 bite/scratch consultations from dogs and cats—an 11.2% increase. About 12,560 cases involved animals displaying abnormal behavior; Long Hai surveillance logged 128 reports of dogs suspected of rabies biting residents. All six deaths occurred in people who did not receive post-exposure vaccination or rabies immunoglobulin, linked to complacency and use of traditional remedies. The city operates 202 vaccination sites (53 public) and 18 immunoglobulin points, and has launched a One Health response including a Sept 28 rally, online briefings, and digital materials. Rabies remains almost 100% fatal after symptoms but preventable with timely wound care and vaccination. A 4-year-old girl in Dong Thap Province died after seven weeks from a suspected dog bite without preventive treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市で狂犬病による死亡者増加、地域社会での曝露リスクは依然高い水準
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市における狂犬病死亡者数の増加と咬傷相談件数の増加が見られるが、ベトナムでは狂犬病は既知の風土病であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクはないため、フルRRAではなく経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムの風土病であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性はない。ホーチミン市当局はワクチン接種拠点拡充やOne Healthキャンペーンなど既に対策を実施しており、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。ドンタップ省での小児死亡例も含め、地域内の予防接種アクセスや意識向上に関する続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: DOH raises Code White alert for 'Queenie'
article.articleSummary: Severe Tropical Storm Queenie (international name Surigae) prompted the Philippines Department of Health to raise Code White to ensure rapid response. The DOH Operations Center remains on 24/7 alert, with Code White response teams, health commodities, and DOH hospital ERs on standby to address road accidents and health emergencies. The DOH is coordinating with the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council, local government units, and regional disaster units as Queenie is expected to intensify into a typhoon but is not forecast to make landfall or directly affect the country. The storm is expected to bring rains and potential flooding; the public is urged to avoid wading through floodwaters to prevent leptospirosis and other diseases. If wading is unavoidable, seek medical attention at the nearest health facility or YAKAP clinic. Published 2026-09-26.

triage.headline_ja: DOHが台風「クイニー」に対しコードホワイト警戒を発令
triage.triage_reason: 台風接近に伴う防災体制（コードホワイト）の発令であり、レプトスピラ症の実際の発生・症例報告ではなく、注意喚起に留まるため。
triage.notes: 記事は台風による災害対応体制の発令が主題であり、レプトスピラ症は洪水時の注意喚起として言及されているのみで、実際の症例発生は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ana Maria Mocanu a fost diagnosticată cu malarie. Drama cruntă prin care a trecut concurenta Asia Express 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ana Maria Mocanu was diagnosed with malaria. The harrowing ordeal endured by the Asia Express 2026 contestant.
article.articleSummary: Malaria was diagnosed in Ana Maria Mocanu at age 11, with recurrences noted after three relapses while she lived in Africa for three years. She describes malaria as an infectious disease that can cause death. Currently, in 2026, Mocanu participates in Asia Express - Drumul Mătăsii with Loredana Chivu, traveling through Uzbekistan and China. The journey places them in challenging scenarios, including periods without phones or money. The article links her malaria history to resilience during the Silk Road adventure, though it does not report laboratory confirmation of any active infection during the show. By recounting childhood illness and a prolonged stay in Africa, the piece provides health context for Mocanu as she navigates the competition in Uzbekistan and China.

triage.headline_ja: アナ・マリア・モカヌがマラリアと診断された。アジア・エクスプレス2026出場者が経験した過酷な体験
triage.triage_reason: これは有名人の子供時代のマラリア罹患歴を回顧する個人的な記事であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の脅威やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は過去（11歳時、アフリカ滞在中）のマラリア罹患歴に関する個人的な回顧であり、現在のウズベキスタンや中国での活動的な感染事例を報告するものではない。地理情報（Africa, Uzbekistan, China）はいずれも対象国リストに含まれないか、現在進行中の感染症イベントとは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: Ditemukan Bakteri E. coli, Hasil Uji Lab Keracunan Massal MBG di Pati Memasuki Tahap Ekspertisi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: E. coli bacteria detected; MBG mass-poisoning lab test results in Pati enter the expert evaluation phase.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 September 2026, Kabupaten Pati Health Department (Dinkes) reports ongoing evaluation of samples from the mass poisoning incident linked to the Free Nutritious Meals (MBG) program in Gembong, Pati, Central Java. Microbiological testing on food, vomitus, and feces has been completed and forwarded to RSUD Soewondo Pati for expert interpretation by clinical pathologists; chemical analyses are not yet available. Authorities have not officially confirmed the bacterial species, though Escherichia coli involvement is suspected. Five samples were tested: nasi bakar, orak-arik tempe, cucumber, watermelon, and crackers; only nasi bakar and tempe samples tested positive for pathogenic bacteria, while cucumber, watermelon, and crackers were negative. The final results will guide MBG Satgas decisions.

triage.headline_ja: E.coli菌を検出、パティ県MBG（給食プログラム）集団食中毒の検査結果は専門家評価段階へ
triage.triage_reason: 学校給食プログラムに関連した集団食中毒事案で病原性細菌（E.coli疑い）が検出されたが、公式な菌種確定や重症度・患者数などの詳細情報が不足しており、国際的拡大リスクも低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 国家的な給食プログラム（MBG）に関連する食中毒事案であり、地元当局と保健局が調査中。患者数・重症度・死亡者の有無など詳細情報が不明なため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: DOH expands patient tracker as dengue, leptospirosis cases surge
article.articleSummary: Philippines' Department of Health (DOH) expanded its Leptospirosis Tracker into a Unified Leptospirosis and Dengue Case Tracker across DOH hospitals and partner government health facilities in response to rising dengue and leptospirosis activity. The system monitors hospital capacity, caseloads, referrals, and resource needs to support timely operational decisions. It tracks bed occupancy and clinical status to identify facilities at or near capacity, guiding patient referrals, surge measures, and resource augmentation. From Aug. 6–19 to Aug. 20–Sept. 2, leptospirosis cases more than doubled from 1,762 to 3,805, while dengue cases rose from 17,342 to 19,792. This reflects an approximate 116% increase for leptospirosis and about 14% for dengue. The expansion aims to improve coordination amid ongoing outbreaks in the Philippines.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱・レプトスピラ症の症例急増を受け、フィリピン保健省が患者追跡システムを拡大
triage.triage_reason: レプトスピラ症の症例数が2週間で倍増（1,762→3,805件）し、デング熱も増加傾向にあることから保健省が追跡システムを拡大しており、政府の関心の高まりとWPRO基準（異常性・重症度・曝露継続）に該当するためフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 季節性（雨季・洪水関連）の可能性が高く、国際的拡大リスクは低いと考えられるが、症例数急増と病床逼迫懸念があるためモニタリングを継続すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus ILI dan ISPA di Kabupaten Bandung Naik, Dinkes Perkuat Pencegahan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of influenza-like illness (ILI) and acute respiratory infection (ARI) in Bandung Regency rise; Health Office strengthens prevention.
article.articleSummary: Bandung Regency, West Java, Indonesia, records rising influenza-like illness (ILI) and acute respiratory infection (ARI) in a two-week period in September 2026, per the Bandung Health Office using the Early Warning and Response System (SKDR). ILI cases rose by 53.3%, ARI by 36.38%. Some ILI patients have been laboratory-confirmed as having a 'super flu,' though not all ILI cases underwent diagnostic testing; Bandung is not a sentinel facility for ILI, so random testing is not conducted. The Health Office continues surveillance for ILI, ARI, and potential outbreaks, with no random sampling due to non-sentinel status. Preventive measures are reinforced: handwashing with soap, cough etiquette, and masking, especially for symptomatic individuals. Influenza is typically self-limiting, so the emphasis remains on public education to boost immunity and prevent transmission during this rise.

triage.headline_ja: バンドン県でILI（インフルエンザ様疾患）とISPA（急性呼吸器感染症）の症例が増加、保健局が予防を強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ様疾患の増加であり重篤性や異常性の明確な証拠はないが、「スーパーフル」との表現や検査体制の不備など情報不足の点があり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事では『スーパーフル』という表現が使われているが、詳細な病原体特定や重症度に関する情報が不足している。地元保健局はSKDRを用いて監視を継続しており、通常の季節性インフルエンザとして自己限定的と説明している。

article.articleHeadline: 7 câu hỏi về vaccine tay chân miệng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven Questions About the Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease Vaccine
article.articleSummary: Hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) in children is mainly caused by Enterovirus 71 (EV71), which can lead to severe neurologic, cardiac, and respiratory complications and death. Vietnam’s HFMD vaccine targets EV71 and is approved for ages 2 months to under 6 years. Schedule: for 2–<24 months, three 0.5 ml intramuscular doses (Dose 2 2 months after Dose 1; Dose 3 at least 10 months after Dose 2); for 2–<6 years, two doses 2 months apart (minimum 56 days). The vaccine provides cross-protection against EV71 subgroups B5 and C4, but does not protect against milder Coxsackievirus A16, A6, or A10. Prior HFMD does not preclude vaccination. In a phase 3 Vietnamese trial (≈2,500 children in Tiền Giang and Đồng Tháp), efficacy ranged 96.8–100%; after 600 days, no EV71 cases in vaccinees vs 22 in placebo (4 hospitalizations). Immunity persists at least 5 years; co-administration with other vaccines is possible at different sites, with caution for fever-related seizures.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病ワクチンに関する7つの質問
triage.triage_reason: 記事はEV71手足口病ワクチンの接種スケジュールや臨床試験結果を解説する情報提供的な内容であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチンのQ&A形式の解説記事であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクに関する報告ではないため、地域特定のイベントとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Tren ISPA dan ILI Naik, Dinkes KBB Minta Masyarakat Waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising Trends in Upper Respiratory Tract Infections (ISPA) and Influenza-Like Illness (ILI); KBB Health Office Urges the Public to Be Vigilant
article.articleSummary: West Bandung Regency Health Office (KBB) urges heightened vigilance for acute respiratory infections (ARI/ISPA) and influenza-like illness (ILI) after rising trends through epidemiological week 36 of 2026. Cumulative SKDR data show ARI cases increasing from 1,780 (week 32) to 2,324 (week 36), and ILI from 95 to 182; pneumonia cases rose from 245 (week 35) to 258 (week 36). Officials warn that the uptick could strain health services if not anticipated and call for enhanced surveillance, early detection, and community education. Preventive measures include clean living practices (handwashing with soap or sanitizer), cough and sneeze etiquette, and masking for symptomatic individuals, especially around high-risk groups. Immunization is encouraged per health guidance. Residents are urged to seek medical care promptly if fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, headaches, or muscle aches develop.

triage.headline_ja: ISPAとILIの傾向が上昇、KBB保健局が住民に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器感染症・インフルエンザ様疾患の増加傾向を報告する地方保健当局の注意喚起であり、通常の季節的変動の範囲内とみられるが、動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 西バンドン県における地方レベルのサーベイランスデータに基づく注意喚起であり、重症度や病原体の特定情報（新型株など）は記載されていない。季節性の増加である可能性が高いが、続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: US pledges $267 million more to fight Ebola in central Africa
article.articleSummary: US pledges an additional $267 million to fight Ebola in central Africa, primarily in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The outbreak, detected in May, is the second deadliest on record after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. Congolese Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka described it as a major test and said the DRC is mobilizing scientific and operational expertise, with recent tangible response results. The pledge brings the Trump administration’s Ebola commitment to $886 million, including $107 million from the Department of Health and Human Services. Officials say the funds will help contain the outbreak at its source by expanding treatment facilities, diagnostics, and medical countermeasures for health workers, as donors pursue a $2 billion funding target announced at the UN General Assembly.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、中央アフリカのエボラ対策に2億6700万ドルを追加拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ流行は史上2番目に死亡率の高いアウトブレイクとされ、米国が大規模な追加資金拠出を発表するなど国際的関心・支援が顕著であるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRCでのエボラ流行への国際的資金支援に関するもの。Angola・米国・アフリカ大陸全体は発生地域として付与されているが、記事本文の主題はDRCの流行であるため対象国としてはDRCのみを採用した。

article.articleHeadline: Ahmedabad Reports 496 Dengue Cases In 20 Days, AMC Steps Up Mosquito Control Drive
article.articleSummary: Ahmedabad reports 496 dengue infections in the first 20 days of September, with 2026 dengue cases totaling 1,084 (Jan 1–Sept 20); August recorded 361. Sept 1–20 also saw 70 malaria and 7 chikungunya (cumulative malaria 386; chikungunya 14). There were 22 falciparum malaria cases in September. AMC intensified vector control: inspections at 1,298 establishments on Sept 22–23 found mosquito breeding at 146 premises and issued 222 notices, collecting ₹6.06 lakh in admin charges. In the West Zone, 55 of 232 locations were breeding-positive, with 93 notices and ₹1.85 lakh collected. Breeding sources include bird feeders, flower-pot plates, stagnant water on terraces, and discarded scrap. Residential-area inspections occur every 15 days, with fogging and disease surveillance ongoing; residents can request assistance via helpline 155303. Emphasis remains on eliminating stagnant water and identifying breeding sites amid the post-monsoon period in Ahmedabad.

triage.headline_ja: アフマダーバードで20日間に496件のデング熱症例、AMCが蚊対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・マラリア・チクングニヤの増加であり、地方自治体が通常の対策（防蚊対策・監視）を実施している状況。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、例年の季節変動の範囲内と考えられるが、症例数の推移は継続監視が望ましい。
triage.notes: モンスーン後の季節性蚊媒介感染症の増加で、地元自治体（AMC）が通常業務として対策を強化している。死亡例や重症例の報告はなく、既存の地域対応能力内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza Meningkat, Dokter Beri Tips Tetap Sehat di Tengah Mobilitas Tinggi dan Padatnya Kendaraan Umum : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza on the Rise, Doctors Share Tips to Stay Healthy Amid High Mobility and Crowded Public Transportation: Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Influenza is rising in Indonesia amid high mobility and crowded public transportation, according to Indonesian Doctors Association (IDI) physician Dr. Fery Rahman. Speaking on Okezone's Morning Zone, he advises practical health measures to curb respiratory infections. Key recommendations: carry and properly use disposable masks in crowded settings; replace masks if wet, dirty, or after sneezing, and dispose of used masks immediately at home rather than reusing them. Second, maintain hand hygiene by carrying hand sanitizer and washing hands with soap and running water after touching shared surfaces such as rails, doors, or poles, and before meals. He emphasizes that these habits are part of everyday cleanliness, not limited to outbreaks, to reduce transmission of respiratory infections. No specific case counts were reported. Article published 26 September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザが増加、医師が高い流動性と混雑した公共交通機関の中で健康を維持するためのヒントを提供
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数や異常性の報告がなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響も認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザ予防に関する一般的な医師のアドバイス記事であり、具体的な症例数増加や異常事態の報告はない。インドネシアが主題国ではあるが、イベントとしての緊急性は低いためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : à l'ONU, la RDC souligne que grâce à la mobilisation nationale et au soutien des partenaires " la riposte engagée produit depuis peu des résultats tangibles "
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: at the UN, the DRC notes that thanks to national mobilization and partner support, the concerted response has recently yielded tangible results.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 September 2026, during the UN General Assembly address on 23 September 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka framed the Ebola response, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, as a test of health sovereignty. The outbreak was declared in May 2026 in Ituri province and has since affected seven provinces and more than 60 health zones, with over 3,300 deaths. She stressed that national mobilization and partner support are yielding tangible progress despite insecurity and population displacement that hinder surveillance, contact tracing, and patient management. The DRC carries experience from 16 prior Ebola outbreaks and is hosting parallel clinical trials to evaluate vaccines and treatments tailored to Bundibugyo. WHO and Africa CDC, alongside clinicians, researchers, and affected communities, contribute to the response and resilience-building.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:国連にてDRCは、国内の動員とパートナーの支援により対応が最近具体的な成果を上げていると述べた
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(ブンディブジョ株)がDRCで7州60以上の保健区域に拡大し3,300人以上の死者を出しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模アウトブレイク（2026年5月宣言、死者3,300人超、7州60以上の保健区域）の継続報道であり、フルRRA対象として妥当。治安悪化・住民避難がサーベイランスや接触者追跡を阻害している点にも留意。

article.articleHeadline: Hơn 100 nghìn người bị chó, mèo, vật nuôi cắn, TPHCM cảnh báo nguy cơ bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 100,000 people bitten by dogs, cats, and other pets; Ho Chi Minh City warns of the risk of rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam: From the start of 2026 through late September, six rabies deaths have occurred in HCMC, with fatalities in the Cu Chi, Hoa Hiep and Long Hai communes. Health facilities have treated 101,384 bites or scratches from dogs, cats, and other pets—up 11.2% year-on-year—among which 12,560 involved animals displaying abnormal behavior suggestive of rabies. In Long Hai, 128 residents reported dogs suspected of rabies. All deaths occurred in individuals who did not receive post-exposure vaccination or rabies immunoglobulin after bites. Key causes include complacency and underestimating wound severity; some pursued folk remedies instead of medical care. The city operates 202 rabies vaccination sites (53 public) and 18 immunoglobulin sites. Authorities urge four actions: vaccinate pets annually, keep dogs leashed and muzzled in public, wash and disinfect wounds for at least 15 minutes and seek prompt medical care, and avoid unproven traditional remedies. Rabies remains nearly 100% fatal after symptoms but is preventable with timely post-exposure measures.

triage.headline_ja: 犬・猫などのペットに噛まれた人が10万人超、ホーチミン市が狂犬病リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 2026年に入りホーチミン市で狂犬病による死亡が6件発生し、咬傷治療件数も前年比11.2%増と拡大しており、公衆衛生上の懸念と行政の警戒感が確認されるためフルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムで毎年発生する風土病的な性質があり、国際的拡大リスクは低い。ただし死亡例の継続発生と咬傷件数の増加、行政による警告発出があるため、地域内対応状況の確認を目的にピックアップと判断した。中国（河南省）は発生地域リストに含まれるが記事内容とは無関係と判断し除外した。

article.articleHeadline: El repte de trobar una vacuna per a l'epidèmia de l'Ebola a la RD del Congo - 3CatInfo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The challenge of finding a vaccine for the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - 3CatInfo
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola epidemic—driven by the Bundibugyo strain—continues, marking the largest Bundibugyo outbreak with over 7,700 laboratory-confirmed cases and more than 3,700 deaths. A vaccine developed for Bundibugyo has begun Phase I safety testing, with field efficacy trials planned in DRC to test protection against this strain. A second trial starts using a vaccine approved for the Zaire strain to evaluate potential cross-protection and to safeguard frontline responders. WHO Africa Emergencies Director Marie Roseline Belizaire, speaking from Kinshasa, highlights the need to test vaccines in the outbreak setting, while MSF notes the importance of protecting health workers like those cited by Nana Mimbu. The outbreak has expanded from three to seven provinces in a conflict-affected, highly mobile mining region with a fragile health system and community distrust; international support remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ流行、ワクチン開発の課題 - 3CatInfo
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyo株による過去最大規模のエボラ流行が継続中で、7,700例超の確定症例・3,700人超の死亡、7州へ拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株としては史上最大の流行。紛争地域・鉱山地帯で人の移動が多く、コミュニティの不信感もあり管理が困難。ワクチン臨床試験（Bundibugyo株用およびZaire株用の交差防御評価）が進行中。WHO・MSFが対応に関与。

article.articleHeadline: Mỗi năm thế giới có khoảng 59.000 người tử vong vì bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: About 59,000 people die from rabies each year worldwide.
article.articleSummary: Rabies causes about 59,000 deaths annually across more than 150 countries, with around 40% of victims under 15 years old. In Vietnam, 2025 saw 77 rabies fatalities, and in the first nine months of 2026 the country recorded 55 deaths. Post-exposure vaccination in 2025 exceeded 1 million people; vaccine and rabies immunoglobulin costs surpassed 2,000 billion VND, about triple the 2017–2021 period. Fatal outcomes are linked to not vaccinating, delayed vaccination, improper wound care, or unproven treatments; access to preventive services remains challenging in remote, mountainous areas. Authorities urge thorough wound washing with soap and water, prompt medical consultation for vaccination, and to avoid self-treatment. Vietnam aims to eliminate dog- and cat-transmitted rabies deaths by 2030 via a One Health approach, coordinating Health with Agriculture–Environment. In Dak Lak province, a national rabies prevention event and drill demonstrated dog vaccination, post-exposure vaccination, and outbreak response after positive test results.

triage.headline_ja: 世界では毎年約59,000人が狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病はベトナムを含め多くの国で発生している既知の風土病であり、本記事は年次統計・啓発報告であって新規の異常発生や急激な拡大を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は世界および国内の狂犬病死亡統計と予防啓発、政府のOne Health戦略（2030年までの犬猫由来狂犬病死撲滅目標）に関する定期的な報告であり、突発的な異常発生を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dozens of whale calves die in Argentina, bacterial infection suspected
article.articleSummary: Dozens of southern right whale calves washed up dead along Argentina's Valdés Peninsula in northern Patagonia; a bacterial infection is the most likely cause, with the bacterium capable of causing systemic disease in calves. No evidence of human-caused factors. Investigations are underway with scientists, including CONICET. The affected species, southern right whales (Eubalaena australis), migrate to coasts of Argentina, Brazil and Uruguay to breed and raise young, with large numbers gathering in the gulf areas of northern Patagonia. A death toll is described as 'fairly high' by CONICET scientist Mariano Coscarella; officials caution that right whale mortality occurs annually and could reflect natural population dynamics. The main hypothesis mirrors outbreaks elsewhere; Valdés Peninsula spans about 4,000 sq km and is a UNESCO site, where nutrient-rich waters from two converging currents sustain breeding grounds for numerous marine mammals.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンでクジラの赤ちゃん数十頭が死亡、細菌感染が疑われる
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンでの野生クジラ（南方セミクジラ）の死亡事例であり、ヒトへの感染症ではなく人為的要因の証拠もないため、公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。対象国での発生でもない。
triage.notes: 本事案は野生動物（クジラ）の細菌感染による死亡であり、人獣共通感染症としての証拠は示されていない。発生地域はアルゼンチンのバルデス半島（パタゴニア）であり、ブラジル・ウルグアイは同種クジラの回遊先として言及されているのみで実際の発生地ではないため、対象国リストのBrazilも除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo breitet sich auf zwei weitere Bezirke aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: the Ebola outbreak in the Congo is spreading to two more districts.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo virus, has spread to two additional health zones, Bulu (Sud-Ubangi Province) and Dungu (Haut-Uele Province, bordering South Sudan), bringing the total affected zones to 63 across seven provinces. By September 23, there were 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cited conflict and displacement as major barriers to reaching communities and tracing contacts, with restricted access and crowding heightening transmission risk. Although overall case counts are trending down and contact tracing, safe burials, and community engagement have improved, transmission remains uneven, and the lack of approved vaccines or therapies for the Bundibugyo strain complicates response and may deter care-seeking. WHO is accelerating vaccine and therapy trials. Tedros called for stronger pandemic preparedness; he noted misinformation about the WHO Pandemic Treaty, adopted May 2025. The article will be updated.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行:コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行がさらに2つの地区に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が7州63地域に拡大し、7890例・3799死亡という重大な公衆衛生被害が発生。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、紛争・避難民により対応が困難でIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 南スーダンとの国境地域(Dungu)への拡大が言及されているが、南スーダン国内での症例発生は記載なし。対象国リストに南スーダンは含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases near 8,000 as outbreak pushes across DRC
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is closing in on 8,000 confirmed cases, with 7,911 cases and 3,801 deaths reported. The epidemic spans 63 health zones across seven provinces, and the latest area is Dungu in Haut-Uélé near the South Sudan border, raising cross-border transmission concerns amid high population movement. In the week ending Sept 20, WHO logged 475 new cases and 222 deaths, lifting the case-fatality ratio to about 48.3%. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment; research into countermeasures is under way. IOM reports as of Sept 21 over 7,700 confirmed cases and more than 3,700 deaths across 60 health zones in seven provinces, with Uganda and nine other neighbours at risk. The outbreak, declared PHEIC in May, remains under international emergency coordination. Ituri remains the most affected province, with spread reaching Haut-Uélé.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ症例が8,000人に迫る、DRCで流行が拡大
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行で、症例7,911人・死亡3,801人（CFR約48.3%）に達し、国境地域（南スーダン国境近郊）への拡大や近隣諸国への波及懸念があるためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ワクチン・特異的治療法未承認のブンディブギョ株による流行で、WHOによりPHEICが宣言されている。ウガンダ・南スーダンなど近隣国への波及リスクが指摘されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: 27 Kasus Super Flu Ditemukan di Sumut, Mayoritas Lansia dan Anak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 27 Cases of Super Flu Found in North Sumatra, Mostly Elderly and Children
article.articleSummary: Influenza A (seasonal, dubbed super flu) cases reach 27 in North Sumatra, Indonesia, not indicating a new pandemic. Dinas Kesehatan Sumut reports detection via two sentinel Influenza-Like Illness sites: Puskesmas Teladan (Medan) and RS Amri Tambunan (Deliserdang). Cases span August–September 2026, with 3 in August and 18 in September; sentinel data likely undercounts total cases due to limited coverage and resources. Symptoms resemble COVID-19 (fever and respiratory issues), but severity varies; no deaths reported among identified patients. Subtyping is performed by sending specimens to Jakarta. Authorities stress continued vigilance for influenza A and B to detect unusual or severe outbreaks early. Preventive measures include wearing masks when ill, hand hygiene, adequate hydration and nutrition, and avoiding close contact during infection, especially for children, the elderly, and pregnant women.

triage.headline_ja: 北スマトラで『スーパーフル』27例確認、大半は高齢者と子ども
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA型の通常の検出事例であり新規パンデミックを示唆しないが、サーベイランス体制の限界や継続的な監視の必要性が言及されているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザAの通常検出事例であり、当局も新規パンデミックではないと明言。死亡例なし。サーベイランスの不完全性（センチネルサイトの限定的カバー）により実際の症例数は過小評価の可能性があるため、続報を注視。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு, சிக்குன்குனியா குறித்து அலர்ட்! விழுப்புரத்தில் தீவிரமாகும் தடுப்பு பணிகள் !
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert on dengue and chikungunya! Prevention efforts intensifying in Viluppuram.
article.articleSummary: On 26 September 2026, Viluppuram district, Tamil Nadu, is intensifying prevention of dengue, chikungunya, viral fever, typhoid, diarrhea, and jaundice-like illnesses during the monsoon. District Collector Shake Abdul Rahman said the health department is conducting surveillance, vector-control, sanitation drives, and rural water-management, with community participation in fumigation and door-to-door campaigns. Measures target Aedes breeding in standing water: cover water containers and drums; weekly washing with bleaching powder or coconut husk; remove unused plastics, tyres, coconut shells, glass, and other debris; maintain a clean environment. Boil drinking water, keep homes mosquito-proof, and secure doors/windows. Children should wear full-body clothing and use bed nets. Seek urgent care for fever with vomiting, abdominal pain, bleeding, or fainting; if fever lasts beyond three days, visit a primary health center or hospital. Report suspected clusters to health workers.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱・チクングニア熱に警戒！ヴィルップラムで予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング・チクングニア・腸チフス等への行政による通常の予防啓発活動であり、具体的な症例数や異常な増加、重症例の報告がないため、フルRRAには進めず経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はモンスーン期における恒例の予防啓発・行政活動が中心で、具体的な症例数・死亡数・アウトブレイクの規模等の情報は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in der DR Kongo: Der Ausbruch weitet sich aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DR Congo: The outbreak is spreading.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak continues to spread, with severe health-system strain in North Kivu where cases rose 73% in three weeks. The World Health Organization warns treatment centers lack personnel and funds; around 300 specialists (nurses, infection-control experts, anesthetists, doctors) are needed per center. Seven provinces are affected; government counts reach 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths. From Aug 31 to Sep 20, Ituri (epicenter) cases fell 26% and Haut-Uele fell 15%, but the outbreak remains out of control. Children under five face the highest risk, with case fatality >60% versus ~40% for adults, and diagnosis is harder in young children. Vaccination has begun in Ituri: 20,000 Ervebo doses prepared for a clinical study to assess efficacy against the current Bundibugyo variant; Ervebo protection is proven for Zaire variant. Health workers will be prioritized; infection fatality remains high.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：アウトブレイクが拡大
triage.triage_reason: 7州に拡大し確認症例7,773件・死亡3,759件と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、医療体制の逼迫や新変異株への対応など異常性・拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAに進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 北キブ州で3週間で症例73%増、5歳未満の致死率60%超と深刻。ブンディブギョ変異株に対するEbola/Erveboワクチンの臨床試験がイトゥリ州で開始されている点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Investigadores tucumanos desarrollaron una vacuna inédita contra infecciones intestinales
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tucumán researchers developed a novel vaccine against intestinal infections.
article.articleSummary: Argentine researchers from Tucumán have developed an oral vaccine to protect against intestinal infections caused by Salmonella and Shigella. In a preclinical program, the vaccine uses a genetically modified, attenuated Salmonella strain administered orally as drops once a year, aimed at children, to elicit immunity against both pathogens. There are currently no vaccines to prevent gastrointestinal disease from Salmonella or Shigella; existing Salmonella vaccines target typhoid fever (Salmonella Typhi). The team seeks a single formulation covering both bacteria, with beta-glucan (fungal) studied as an adjuvant to boost the immune response. Early tests show beta-glucans do not affect bacterial viability for at least two months, allowing progression to formulation studies. INSIBIO—the joint institute of Universidad Nacional de Tucumán and CONICET—leads the work, with María Victoria Pacello and Mónica Alejandra Delgado. Results will be presented at AUGM in Porto Alegre, Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: トゥクマン州の研究者が腸管感染症に対する新規ワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンでのワクチン研究開発に関する記事であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。また対象国リストに該当する国での発生事例もない。
triage.notes: 本記事はアルゼンチン・トゥクマン州の研究機関によるサルモネラ・シゲラ用経口ワクチンの開発研究に関する報道であり、実際の疾病発生事例ではない。発生地域としてBrazilが付与されているが、これは研究成果発表地（ポルトアレグレ）に言及しているためであり、ブラジルでの感染症発生を意味しない。対象国リストにアルゼンチンは含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Merebak, Kenali Tanda Bahaya pada Anak yang Harus ke IGD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Is Spreading: Recognize Danger Signs in Children Who Need to Go to the Emergency Department
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is resurging in Indonesia. As of 26 September 2026, data from the Ministry of Health show influenza cases rising to 46% of monitored infections, up from 35% the prior week, with 42% of cases detected in children aged 0–4 years. Most cases can be managed at home, but risk of complications is higher for children under five and those with asthma, diabetes, or heart or lung disease. Parents should seek urgent care if a child has difficulty breathing, chest retractions, blue lips or face, cannot wake or interact, severe dehydration, seizures, or fever/cough that worsens after temporary improvement. Annual influenza vaccination is recommended to reduce risk. Mayapada Hospital’s Pediatric Emergency Center provides 24/7 pediatric emergency services with International Joint Commission (JCI)–accredited facilities, including Jakarta Selatan (Lebak Bulus, Kuningan), Tangerang, Bogor, Bandung, Surabaya, and Jakarta Timur. Contact Emergency Call 150990 or MyCare for access.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAが流行、子どもの救急受診が必要な危険サインを知ろう
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの流行に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限等の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: インドネシア保健省のモニタリングデータに基づく季節性インフルエンザ流行に関する市民向け健康情報記事。特定の病院サービス紹介も含まれており、広報的な内容。

article.articleHeadline: الذكاء الاصطناعي يسرّع متابعة وباء إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Artificial intelligence speeds up monitoring of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak monitoring in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is being accelerated by digital tools and AI. Despite difficult ground access, power and communications shortages, response teams rely on satellite links and mobile apps to transmit data. In June, Africa CDC announced Starlink delivered 150 satellite communication kits to Ituri to speed data transfer and field coordination. In September, CEPI convened Anthropic, WHO Africa, and the National Institute for Biomedical Research (INRB) to explore Claude, Anthropic’s AI assistant, for real-time data processing. Regions frequently send data via WhatsApp, which Claude ingests, consolidates, and compares to prior reports, highlighting changes. The daily reporting process has dropped from about a full day to under one hour. A reported 70 new confirmed Ebola cases in 24 hours underscores the need for rapid data analysis to guide outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: AIがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行の監視を加速
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部（イトゥリ州）で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、24時間で70例の新規確定例が報告されており、疾患の重篤性と国際的関心の高さから精査が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はAIツール（Claude、Starlink衛星通信）によるエボラ監視の効率化がテーマだが、24時間で70例の新規確定例という報告は既存アウトブレイクの規模拡大を示唆しており、フルリスク評価での続報確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak expands to two more health zones in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to two more health zones, Bulu in Sud-Ubangi province and Dungu in Haut-Uélé province, bringing the total affected to 63 across seven provinces. As of September 23, the WHO reports 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths. Ongoing conflict and population displacement hamper efforts to reach affected communities, trace contacts, and contain transmission, though overall case numbers are declining with improvements in contact tracing, safe burials and community engagement; transmission remains uneven across areas. The Bundibugyo strain lacks a licensed vaccine or specific treatment; clinical trials are underway to assess potential vaccines and therapies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の流行が新たに2つの保健地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(7,890例、死亡3,799)が7州63地域に拡大し、紛争地域での対応困難とワクチン未承認という重大な公衆衛生上の懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。

article.articleHeadline: New pandemic fears as bat coronavirus has 'high potential' to spread in humans
article.articleSummary: In Brazil, researchers report a newly discovered bat coronavirus, HKU5-CoV-2, with a furin cleavage site on its spike protein, a trait that contributed to SARS-CoV-2’s infectiousness. Laboratory tests show HKU5-CoV-2 can affect human lungs and intestines via the same entry mechanism as Covid-19, though its current infectiousness is described as lower, and there are no reported human transmissions. Scientists deem the virus’s zoonotic potential high, noting it can bind to multiple mammal species and could mutate to enable human-to-human spread. No cases or deaths have been linked to this virus, and experts emphasize that existing virology work could enable rapid vaccine development if transmission begins. The findings underscore ongoing concern about zoonotic spillover amid growing wildlife-human contact and climate change, especially in a Brazilian bat population; public risk remains low for now as of 2026-09-26.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなパンデミックへの懸念:コウモリ由来コロナウイルスがヒトに感染する『高い可能性』を持つ

triage.notes: 研究段階の報告であり、実際のヒト感染事例は確認されていない。ラボ実験結果に基づく潜在的リスク評価であり、パンデミック発生を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Fantástico apresenta série de Sônia Bridi sobre a epidemia de Ebola na África - Fala Canedo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fantástico presents Sônia Bridi's series about the Ebola epidemic in Africa - Fala Canedo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the focus of a two-episode Fantástico series led by Sônia Bridi. The program highlights the social and economic repercussions as health systems are strained and daily life is disrupted. The article does not provide case or death counts, but identifies drivers such as malnutrition, weak health infrastructure, political fragility, and environmental changes like deforestation and ecosystem disruption that may propel transmission. Health workers mobilize vaccination campaigns, raise awareness, and deploy experimental vaccines and innovative therapies amid international solidarity. It emphasizes uncertainty and the need for coordinated, long-term investments in health infrastructure, surveillance, and research to prepare for future outbreaks. The series aims to inform and provoke action on how society can respond to Ebola and similar epidemics in Africa.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Rabies Day, Aceh Provincial Department of Animal Husbandry Holds Free Rabies Vaccination at Harapan Bangsa Stadium.
article.articleSummary: World Rabies Day 2026 activities in Banda Aceh, Aceh Province, Indonesia, offer free rabies vaccination for pets and free treatment slots. Theme: 'One Action for Rabies, Stronger Together' / 'Rabies Can Be Prevented.' For info, contact Aceh Veterinary Clinic at 0812-6931-1600.
