triage.triage_reason: 野生象での炭疽確認は稀な事例で人獣共通感染症としての長期リスク（土壌中芽胞の残存、牛へのワクチン接種等）はあるが、ヒトへの感染や重症例は報告されておらず、国際的拡大の兆候もないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本事案はインド・マディヤプラデーシュ州の野生象（4月に死亡）に関する炭疽感染の続報であり、ヒトへの感染例は報告されていない。牛への予防接種等、種間伝播対策が講じられている点は人獣共通感染症としての監視継続の必要性を示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: San Lazaro Hospital reports 40 deaths due to leptospirosis
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis outbreak at San Lazaro Hospital in Manila, Philippines, with 40 deaths reported as of Sept. 24. The hospital noted a rising fatality toll this year, increasing from 24 deaths on Sept. 10 to 27 on Sept. 14 and 31 on Sept. 18, reaching 40. Overall admissions for leptospirosis reached 823. Of these, one patient is in intensive care and three are on hemodialysis. Dr. Rontgene Solante, head of adult infectious diseases and tropical medicine at SLH, said pulmonary hemorrhage is the most common cause of death in this outbreak, describing it as bleeding in the lungs. The Department of Health reported 10,936 suspected leptospirosis cases as of Sept. 16, a 38% increase from 7,931 cases in the same period in 2025, indicating a continuing surge.

triage.headline_ja: サン・ラザロ病院、レプトスピラ症による死者40人を報告
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンでレプトスピラ症による死者が急増（40人）し、全国の疑い症例数も前年比38%増と異常な増加を示しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は毎年雨季（洪水時）にフィリピンで発生する風土病だが、今年は前年比38%増と異常な増加を示している。人-人感染はなく国際拡大リスクは低いが、国内公衆衛生上の負荷は大きい。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: ИДВА ЛИ ПОРЕДНАТА ОПАСНОСТ? Учени откриха нов коронавирус!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the next danger coming? Scientists have discovered a novel coronavirus!
article.articleSummary: As of 26 September 2026, researchers report the discovery of a novel Brazilian coronavirus variant, HKU5-CoV-2, found in bats and bearing a furin cleavage site on its spike protein—a feature linked to SARS-CoV-2’s high transmissibility. Laboratory data indicate the Brazilian virus can infect human lungs and intestines via the same mechanism as COVID-19. While the immediate threat is considered low, Dr. Gareth Nye of the University of Salford notes the virus’s zoonotic potential is high, given its ability to bind to diverse mammalian hosts and potentially adapt to humans. No human-to-human transmission has been reported. If transmission between people were to occur, a suitable vaccine could be rapidly developed and deployed. Officials say there is no need for panic now, though pandemics have often arisen from population growth, climate change, and increased wildlife contact.

triage.headline_ja: 次なる危険が迫っているのか？科学者が新型コロナウイルスを発見！
triage.triage_reason: コウモリ由来の新規コロナウイルス（HKU5-CoV-2）がブラジルで発見されたが、ヒト-ヒト感染の報告はなく、専門家も現時点でのパニックは不要としている。zoonotic potentialは高いとされ、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はコウモリ由来の新規コロナウイルスに関する基礎研究報告であり、ヒトへの感染事例は確認されていない。ブラジルのコウモリで発見されたウイルスであるため、Brazilのみをverified_locationsに含めた。英国・北マケドニア・チェコ等はBluedotの誤タグと判断し除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: rastreio de contatos no Congo é falho, diz CDC - 26/09/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: contact tracing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is flawed, says CDC - September 26, 2026.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains driven by uncontained community transmission as contact tracing undercounts exposures: about 30,000 potential contacts identified versus roughly 420,000 expected for 7,000 confirmed cases (60 contacts per case). Approximately 80% of new confirmed cases were detected among people not on contact lists, signaling transmission outside monitoring. Jean Kaseya, Director-General of Africa CDC, cautioned that control is unlikely while transmission is widespread in communities. The World Health Organization reported spread to two more health zones—Bulu in Sud Ubangi and Dungu in Haut-Uele—bringing the total to 63 health zones across seven provinces, with Ituri as the epicenter; some areas show signs of deceleration. Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka called it a major test, with response measures beginning to yield results. If case detection via contacts improved and health workers remained uninfected, control could be possible within four weeks. About $2.9 billion pledged for the response, including $886 million from the U.S.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:コンゴ民主共和国での接触者追跡は不十分、CDCが指摘 - 2026年9月26日
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで7000人の確定患者・63保健地区・7州に拡大し、市中感染が制御できていない大規模流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国は資金拠出のみで発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。7000例確定、63保健地区、7州に拡大中で流行制御が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: फरीदाबाद में डेंगू के मरीज बढ़कर 21 हुए, बादशाह खान अस्पताल में 8 बेड के सहारे चल रहा मेडिकल वार्ड - faridabad dengue cases rise govt hospital facilities struggle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Faridabad, dengue cases rise to 21; medical ward at Badshah Khan Hospital running with 8 beds.
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Faridabad rise to 21 with two new confirmations; malaria 3. Badshah Khan Hospital’s medical ward operates with eight beds, housing TB and dengue patients together amid crowding; emergency department lacks adequate arrangements for dengue-suspected patients (three in medical ward, two in ER). Ninety? sorry, 19 of the 21 dengue patients have been declared healthy. Most dengue and malaria patients are treated in private hospitals. Authorities stress that any fever could be dengue or malaria, with blood tests conducted for all fever cases and self-medication discouraged; recovered dengue patients are discharged home. Daily patient load exceeds 2,000, with viral fever, cough/cold, and infections common. Dr. Jayant Ahuja, Chief Medical Officer, urges caution and awareness.

triage.headline_ja: ファリダバードでデング熱患者21人に増加、バードシャー・カーン病院の医療病棟は8床で対応に苦慮
triage.triage_reason: デング熱21例・マラリア3例と小規模で、21例中19例は回復済み。季節性の通常範囲の流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性が低い。
triage.notes: 地域の病院の病床逼迫が報じられているが、患者数は少なく季節性のデング熱・マラリア流行の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Focarul de Ebola se extinde în Congo. Aproape 3.800 de oameni au murit, iar virusul a ajuns în 63 de zone sanitare
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is spreading in Congo. Nearly 3,800 people have died, and the virus has reached 63 health zones.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyro Ebola continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo, now affecting 63 health zones across seven provinces. As of 23 September, 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths (mortality 48.1%) have been reported, with 1,966 recoveries. New cases appear in Bulu, Sud-Ubangi, and Dungu, Haut-Uele, near the South Sudan border, raising fears of wider spread. Ituri remains the hardest hit, followed by North Kivu. Ongoing conflict and displacement impede response; healthcare access is uneven, and contact tracing and safe burials are hampered in some areas. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola; WHO is accelerating trials. Tedros warns insecurity impedes surveillance and urges pandemic preparedness, while clarifying misinformation about the May 2025 WHO Pandemic Accord.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラの流行が拡大。約3,800人が死亡し、ウイルスは63の保健地域に到達
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.1%の大規模エボラ流行が7州63保健地域に拡大し、南スーダン国境付近にも波及。紛争による対応の困難さと国際的拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 南スーダン国境付近での新規症例発生が報告されているが、南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ワクチン・治療法未承認、紛争による対応困難、WHO Tedros事務局長のコメントあり。フルRRAでの継続評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Naik, Orangtua Wajib Kenali Tanda Bahaya pada Anak yang Harus Dibawa ke IGD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases on the rise; parents must recognize the danger signs in children that require a trip to the ER.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases are rising in Indonesia, with the Ministry of Health reporting influenza incidence up to 46% versus 35% the prior week, and 42% of cases among children aged 0–4 years. Mayapada Hospital experts warn influenza A remains a common seasonal flu. Classic symptoms include abrupt fever, cough, headache, muscle pains, sore throat, runny nose, and fatigue; young children may also experience nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. Most pediatric cases recover in 3–7 days, but monitor beyond fever: ensure the child stays active, eats and drinks, and breathes normally, especially under five or with asthma, diabetes, or heart or lung disease. Seek emergency care if the child has trouble breathing, chest retractions, blue lips or face, cannot wake or interact, or shows dehydration signs (minimal urination, dry mouth, no tears). Seizures and relapse of fever or cough after improvement also warrant urgent attention.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型症例が増加、子どもの危険な兆候を親が認識し救急搬送すべき場合
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの流行増加を報じる一般的な健康啓発記事であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、小児での増加率が高く経過観察の対象とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常の流行報道であり、重症度や異常性の情報は限定的。小児における感染率上昇（42%が0-4歳）が注目点。

article.articleHeadline: Weekly Health Update | WHO Africa Issues New Breast Cancer Guidance; Nigeria Lassa Fever Fatality Rate Rises
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC has surpassed 7,700 confirmed cases and 3,732 deaths across seven provinces and 63 health zones as of Sept 23, 2026. North Kivu cases are rising sharply, while Ituri and Haut-Uélé are easing; case fatality in North Kivu exceeds 65%, with under-5 mortality high. A Bunia vaccination campaign with Ervebo is under way. Thirty-three recoveries were reported in the last 24 hours. Cross-border risk has grown with Dungu near the South Sudan border. Nearly $3 billion in Ebola response commitments have been mobilized; Africa CDC calls for precise fund tracing. In the Lake Chad Basin (Cameroon, Chad, Mali, Niger, Nigeria), WHO and KSrelief commit $5.3 million for cholera prevention and response, including vaccination and WASH. Nigeria reports 1,086 Lassa fever cases and 259 deaths (23.9% fatality). WHO Africa on Sept 21 issued new breast cancer primary-care guidance to boost early detection and referral, addressing late-stage presentation.

triage.headline_ja: 週次保健アップデート：WHOアフリカが乳がんに関する新ガイダンスを発表、ナイジェリアではラッサ熱の致死率が上昇
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で進行中のブンディブギョ型エボラ流行が7,700例超・死亡3,732例、致死率65%超に達し、南スーダン国境付近での越境リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行、ナイジェリアのラッサ熱、湖チャド盆地諸国（カメルーン・チャド・マリ・ニジェール・ナイジェリア）でのコレラ対応など複数国・複数疾患を扱う週次サマリー。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみのため、verified_locationsはDRCに限定した。ナイジェリアのラッサ熱情報も重要だが対象国リスト外のため個別評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Pets battle tick uptick in rainy season
article.articleSummary: Kolkata reports a spike in tick fever among pets, including strays, as humid monsoon rains create ideal tick breeding conditions. Veterinarians warn of lethargy, loss of appetite, swollen lymph nodes, pale gums and dark urine, with tick-borne diseases potentially causing respiratory distress and skin issues. Ehrlichiosis and Babesiosis are highlighted as consequential forms of tick fever; if not treated, infections can become complicated and lead to secondary problems. Fleas can carry tapeworms that are transmitted by bites. Monsoon-focused care includes daily grooming, regular hydration, and cooked meals, plus routine health checks and tick-control with sprays or tablets; there is no vaccine for this condition. Pet parents should monitor for redness, itching, rashes, hair loss or unpleasant odour and seek veterinary advice. Reports come from Kolkata, including New Alipore and Belgachhia Veterinary Hospital.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン時季にペットのマダニ媒介熱が増加
triage.triage_reason: ペット（犬猫等）のマダニ媒介疾患に関する獣医学的な注意喚起記事であり、ヒトの公衆衛生上のリスクや異常な流行を示す内容はない。
triage.notes: 本記事はペットの動物疾患（Babesiosis、Ehrlichiosis等）に関する季節的な健康アドバイス記事であり、ヒト感染症のシグナルではないため対象国に該当なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: US Adds $267 Million to Ebola Response, Mostly for DRC
article.articleSummary: US adds $267 million to Ebola response, bringing direct health and humanitarian assistance to $887 million, announced September 23 at the UN General Assembly and focused largely on the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The funding will support Ebola treatment units, safe burial teams, expanded surveillance, PPE, medical supplies, and contact tracing, contributing to a broader $2 billion target. The outbreak, detected in May, is the second deadliest on record behind 2014–2016 West Africa. The DRC accounts for most cases and deaths: 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths (WHO data through Sept 23). Ituri remains hardest-hit; North Kivu is the second most affected with 567 confirmed cases in the 21 days to Sept 23. Sud Ubangi is the seventh province affected. Bundibugyo virus may have circulated months before first confirmations, hindered by aid cuts, surveillance gaps, lack of vaccines/treatments, and armed conflict in eastern DRC. Uganda interrupted local transmission on July 28 after 42 days without a locally acquired case; imported cases remained possible, with Uganda’s end announced Aug 27 by WHO/Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ対応に2億6700万ドルを追加拠出、大半はコンゴ民主共和国向け
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは史上2番目の規模（確定症例7,890件、死亡3,799件）で、複数州に拡大し国際支援が急増しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・アンゴラ・米国も発生地域として挙げられているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダは現地伝播を7月28日に中断済みで、輸入症例のリスクのみ残存していた（WHO/Africa CDCが8月27日に終息宣言）。主要な流行地はコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州・北キブ州・スドゥバンギ州。

article.articleHeadline: Врач Чернышова перечислила симптомы гонконгского гриппа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Chernysheva listed the symptoms of the Hong Kong flu.
article.articleSummary: First cases of a mutated Hong Kong influenza strain have been identified in Russia. Symptoms do not differ from ordinary influenza: abrupt fever to 38–40°C, weakness, headache, eye and muscle pains. Strain typing cannot be done without laboratory tests. Clinicians advise staying home and taking sick leave at the onset to prevent spread, along with bed rest and generous warm fluids. For high fever, antipyretics may be taken, under medical advice. Antiviral medications could help within the first forty-eight hours, but only after consultation with a doctor. Vaccination remains the most effective preventive measure; the therapist cited September–October as an optimal window for vaccination. The report notes no nationwide case counts or outbreak details beyond the initial detections, and emphasizes laboratory confirmation for strain identification and ongoing surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: チェルヌイシェワ医師、香港型インフルエンザの症状を列挙
triage.triage_reason: ロシアで香港型インフルエンザ変異株の初期症例が報告されたが、全国的な症例数や集団発生の詳細は不明で、季節性インフルエンザの範囲を超える重症性・拡大リスクの情報も不足している。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアでの香港型インフルエンザ変異株の初期症例であり、対象国リスト（中国・香港含む）はいずれも記事の主題国ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。中国・香港は疾患名の由来（Hong Kong flu）としての言及のみで、発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: जांच में डेंगू के तीन तो टाइफाइड का एक मरीज निकला पॉजिटिव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three dengue cases and one typhoid patient tested positive.
article.articleSummary: Etawah district, Uttar Pradesh, reports persistent viral fever, dengue, and typhoid as the monsoon continues. As of 26 September 2026, the district hospital treated over 150 patients after the latest rainfall. Pathology antigen testing confirmed three dengue cases and one typhoid case. With rain from Friday evening through Saturday, more infections are feared; outpatient department remained crowded, and waterlogging impeded access. Inpatients include around 40 fever cases and 10 dengue patients. Routine testing flagged 19 dengue, 21 malaria, and 22 typhoid cases. The three dengue-positive patients are Soomya, 24, of Inguri; Manorama, 35, of Chandpur; and Sunil Kumar, 50, of Gopiyapur. The single typhoid case was confirmed by antigen test; no further patient details provided. Doctors urged heightened precautions in this season.

triage.headline_ja: 検査でデング熱3例、腸チフス1例が陽性と判明
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン季節の地域的なデング熱・腸チフス・マラリアの季節性増加であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクはなく、通常の季節的公衆衛生対応の範囲内である。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節に例年みられるデング熱・腸チフス・マラリアの局地的な増加であり、地元病院内で管理可能な規模。国レベルでの異常性や社会的関心の高まりを示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Asesinado por un grupo armado un agente de respuesta al ébola en el este de la RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola response agent killed by an armed group in eastern DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola response worker supervising a handwashing post was killed by an unidentified armed group on Saturday in Bashua, North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The attack on the Beni–Butembo road at the toll plaza disrupted access for outbreak response; FARDC and police intervened, but officials warned that access remains fragile amid security risks and community distrust. Earlier, a young woman died when police fired during burial protests in Katula, Beni, underscoring security challenges to Ebola control. As of September 24, the National Institute of Public Health (INSP) of the DRC reports 7,946 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,833 deaths since the outbreak began on May 15; 2,001 recovered, 848 hospitalized/isolated, 48.2% case fatality, and 79.2% contact tracing. The outbreak affects 63 health zones across Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu and South Ubangi. It is the second-deadliest and most contagious Ebola outbreak globally, behind 2014–2016 West Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ対応要員が武装集団に殺害される
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（7,946症例、致死率48.2%）が治安悪化により対応困難化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にナイジェリア(Lagos State等)が含まれるが、記事本文はDRC（北キブ州バシュア等）のみに言及しており、ナイジェリアでの発生は確認されないため除外した。既知の進行中アウトブレイクであり、本記事は治安要因による対応阻害を報告する続報的内容。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: UAE lifts travel restrictions on Ugandan nationals - The Observer Media Ltd
article.articleSummary: UAE lifts travel restrictions on Ugandan nationals after Uganda's Ebola outbreak ends, announced by NCEMA in coordination with MoHAP and ICP, following evaluation of the epidemiological situation and Uganda's completion of the internationally recognized monitoring period. Precautionary measures remain for the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and South Sudan due to ongoing outbreaks in those countries. UAE had imposed visa suspensions on June 6, 2026 for Uganda, DRC and South Sudan to bolster preparedness. Uganda's Foreign Affairs Minister Adonia Ayebare said the lift is subject to a UAE delegation visiting Uganda's Civil Aviation Authority to assess preparedness. The UAE will monitor developments and adjust measures as risk changes. The easing impacts Uganda's labor export sector, with an estimated 100,000–160,000 Ugandans in the UAE, mainly in Dubai, Sharjah and Abu Dhabi, contributing about $260–350 million in remittances annually.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：UAEがウガンダ国民への渡航制限を解除
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は主にUAEによる渡航制限の解除・維持に関する行政的措置を報じるものであり、ウガンダの流行は終息済み。DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）では流行が継続中とされるが、本記事に新規の疫学的詳細は含まれておらず、既知の状況の延長線上にあるため、フルRRAへの即時移行よりも続報の注視が適切と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はUAEの渡航制限緩和（ウガンダ）であり、ウガンダ自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは継続中の流行地として言及されているため含めたが、本記事内に新規の症例数・死亡者数等の具体的疫学情報はなし。南スーダンも言及されているが対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Why this island paradise has the world's fastest-growing HIV epidemic
article.articleSummary: Fiji confronts two intertwined epidemics: HIV and meth addiction. HIV cases have risen 12-fold since 2010–2025; by mid-September 2026 the government declared a national emergency, with 9,000 people living with HIV and roughly 1 in 60 adults affected. At AIDS 2026 in Rio, Fiji's HIV lead Jason Mitchell called it the fastest-growing HIV epidemic globally, two-thirds of cases aged 20–34. Meth use fuels transmission via shared injections; bluetoothing spreads HIV in settings of poverty and needle scarcity. Fiji is a transit hub for meth between South America and Australia/NZ. Sexual transmission accounts for roughly 50% of new cases in 2025; condom use is low (24% of men, 9% of women with multiple partners used a condom last sex). In 2025, 59 babies were born with HIV. Australian funding of $48 million (Aug 2026) aims to expand testing, diagnosis and treatment; antenatal HIV testing rollout prioritized; antiretrovirals to prevent mother-to-child transmission.

triage.headline_ja: なぜこの楽園の島が世界で最も急速に拡大するHIV流行を抱えているのか
triage.triage_reason: フィジーにおけるHIV流行に関する記事であり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）のいずれにも該当しないため、本トリアージの監視対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はフィジーにおけるHIV流行（薬物乱用との関連含む）。発生地域リストにあるRio de Janeiro・ブラジルはAIDS 2026会議の開催地として言及されているに過ぎず、実際の流行発生国ではない。オーストラリア・ニュージーランド・フィジーはいずれも対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Perú refuerza la vacunación contra el sarampión tras la primera muerte en décadas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Peru strengthens measles vaccination after first death in decades.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Peru intensifies after the first death in decades: a 16-year-old unvaccinated boy from Alto Monte, Loreto, died from pneumonia-related complications. Peru reports 2,357 confirmed measles cases and about 6,114 suspected across regions including Loreto, Puno, Arequipa, Madre de Dios, Cusco, Ucayali, Lima, Callao and Piura. The death highlights long-standing vaccination gaps; as of Sept 16, only 46.7% of target population had received the second SPR dose and 56.1% the first. Access in the Amazon is challenging, with river travel and community transmission; cross-border risk exists from Tabatinga, Brazil (three cases). In response, the Ministry deployed 19 vaccination brigades and 4 care brigades in Alto Monte, vaccinating 23,000 people. Authorities expanded vaccination to ages 6 months–29 years in active areas, and outbreak blocks vaccinate up to age 59 within 12-block radius. The national campaign began in April, with 1.2 million doses administered and more than 2 million doses available.

triage.headline_ja: ペルー、数十年ぶりの麻疹による死亡を受けてワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹による数十年ぶりの死亡例が発生し、確定症例2,357件・疑い症例6,114件と大規模な流行が続いており、ブラジル国境地域（タバチンガ）にも感染が波及していることから、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 主たる発生国はペルー（対象国リスト外）だが、ブラジル・タバチンガで3例の確定症例が報告されており、越境感染のリスクが確認されているためブラジルのみを対象国として計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia Calls for Stronger Pandemic Preparedness - ZNBC
article.articleSummary: Zambia calls for stronger global pandemic preparedness and cooperation to prevent and respond to future pandemics. Health Minister ROMA CHILENGI delivered Zambia's national statement at the United Nations High-Level Meeting on Pandemic Prevention, Preparedness and Response, speaking on behalf of President HAKAINDE HICHILEMA. Preparedness must be properly planned, financed and tested to ensure countries can respond effectively to health emergencies. Zambia commits to working with other Member States, the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention - Africa CDC -, the United Nations and the World Health Organization. The COVID-19 pandemic showed how a health emergency can quickly develop into an economic, social and development crisis, and exposed inequalities in access to vaccines, diagnostic services, medicines and other life-saving technologies. The experience calls for stronger global cooperation and fairer access to essential health products and technologies.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア、より強固なパンデミック対応強化を呼びかけ - ZNBC
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症発生報告ではなく、国連ハイレベル会合での政策的声明に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態としての基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去のCOVID-19パンデミックの経験を踏まえた将来的なパンデミック対策強化の呼びかけであり、現在進行中の感染症発生事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: മരുന്നുക്ഷാമത്തിനിടെ  പകർച്ചവ്യാധിയിൽ 10 മരണം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 10 deaths due to an infectious disease during medicine shortage
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-26, ten deaths from infectious diseases were reported amid severe medicine shortages. Five deaths were due to smallpox, three to influenza, one to yellow fever, and one to dengue fever. Newly confirmed cases include 66 smallpox and 291 dengue. Influenza infections have surged to three times the previous year, while hospitals report no influenza vaccine stock and shortages of antibiotics and urgent IV fluids for critically ill patients. The shortage of doxycycline is implicated in hindering smallpox control. The severity is compounded by floods that left many areas waterlogged, delaying preventive medicines to affected communities. The highest burden is in Kerala’s Malappuram, Kozhikode, Thrissur, Palakkad, and Thiruvananthapuram districts. No details were provided on imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 医薬品不足の中、感染症で10人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 天然痘（根絶疾患）による死亡例の報告は極めて異常であり、洪水による医薬品供給の遅延と相まって複数感染症（インフルエンザ・デング熱・黄熱病）の症例急増と死亡が確認されているため、IHR基準に複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 天然痘(Smallpox)の報告は1980年のWHO根絶宣言と矛盾するため、水痘(Chickenpox)の誤訳・誤分類の可能性が高い。ただし情報が確認できないため『異常』として扱い、続報で疾患名の正確性を確認する必要がある。洪水による医薬品供給網の混乱が複合的リスクを高めている点にも注意。

article.articleHeadline: "Вопрос не если, а когда": глава ВОЗ предупредил о следующей пандемии
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "The question is not whether, but when": WHO chief warned about the next pandemic.
article.articleSummary: On September 25, 2026, in New York at the UN General Assembly, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that a new respiratory pathogen poses a major threat, potentially yielding consequences similar to COVID-19. That same day, a second high-level meeting of the UN General Assembly on pandemic prevention, preparedness, and response focused on strengthening the international health-security architecture. He stressed that the next pandemic is not a question of if but when, urging readiness as outbreaks continue in various countries. He cited the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo as an example underscoring the need for preparedness. The WHO advocates enhanced epidemiological surveillance, international information-sharing on pathogens, and timely access to medical countermeasures. The comments come after COVID-19 demonstrated how rapidly respiratory pathogens can spread and strain health systems.

triage.headline_ja: 「問題は起こるかどうかではなく、いつ起こるかだ」―WHO事務局長が次のパンデミックを警告
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はWHO事務局長による一般的なパンデミック備え強化の呼びかけ・演説内容であり、具体的な新規アウトブレイクの発生情報や症例データは含まれていない。DRCのエボラは既知の事例として例示されたのみで新情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO事務局長の国連総会での一般的な演説内容が主題であり、特定の新規アウトブレイクに関する具体的なデータは提供されていない。DRCのエボラ流行は既存の事例として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ernakulam continues to report highest number of influenza cases in Keralam
article.articleSummary: Ernakulam district in Kerala reports the highest influenza activity with 969 cases recorded by Sept 16, while the state logged 2,205 confirmed influenza cases in September and 20 deaths. District official Dr. R. Shahirsha warns of a potential fever surge in April next year linked to El Niño, and emphasizes preventing person-to-person transmission. The 'Arogyabheri' epidemic prevention plan, launched in September across local bodies, targets public awareness and sanitation to curb spread amid rising H1N1, West Nile and chikungunya activity. In addition to influenza, the district reported 58 confirmed and 12 suspected leptospirosis cases and 649 suspected with 234 confirmed dengue this month, including four leptospirosis deaths. Authorities note travel hub status and ongoing monsoon, with expectations that the flu season will ease as the monsoon ends and ground dries; fever cases persist due to festive-season spread.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州エルナクラム県、引き続きインフルエンザ症例数が州内最多を記録
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のインフルエンザ・デング・レプトスピラ症等の複合流行で死亡例もあるが、地域的・季節的要因（モンスーン、El Niño）による予測可能な事象であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 複数の媒介動物感染症（デング、チクングニア）と呼吸器感染症（インフルエンザ、H1N1）が同時流行し、地元当局が独自の防疫計画（Arogyabheri）を実施中。季節性かつ既知の流行パターンであり、外部支援の必要性についての記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Why this island paradise has the world's fastest-growing HIV epidemic
article.articleSummary: Fiji faces two intertwined epidemics: HIV and crystal meth. HIV cases have risen 12-fold since 2010, with about 9,000 people living with virus and 1 in 60 adults infected. September, Fiji declared a national emergency. At AIDS 2026 in Rio, Jason Mitchell called Fiji’s HIV rise the fastest-growing in the world, with two-thirds of new infections among 20–34-year-olds. A key driver is meth use, injected by youth, fueling transmission via shared needles. Bluetoothing — injecting one person’s blood into another — and needle shortages have amplified spread, along with risky sexual practices that accounted for half of 2025 new cases. Condom use remains low (2021 survey: 24% of men, 9% of women with multiple partners used a condom). Australia has pledged $48 million to expand testing and treatment; antenatal HIV testing aims to curb mother-to-child transmission, with 59 babies born HIV-positive in 2025. Early diagnosis and antiretrovirals are prioritized.

triage.headline_ja: なぜこの楽園の島が世界最速のHIV流行を抱えているのか
triage.triage_reason: フィジーにおけるHIV流行の記事であり、対象国リストに該当する国（ブラジルはAIDS会議開催地として言及されているのみ）が実際の発生地域として確認できないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はフィジーにおけるHIV/覚醒剤流行であり、Rio de Janeiro（ブラジル）はAIDS 2026会議の開催地として言及されているのみで発生地域ではない。オーストラリアも支援国として言及されているのみ。対象国リストにフィジー・オーストラリアは含まれず、ブラジルも実発生地域ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: На Украине обнаружена новая неизвестная инфекция
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new unknown infection has been detected in Ukraine.
article.articleSummary: New unknown infection detected in Ukraine, not clearly COVID-19 or influenza. In Ukraine, patients present fever, severe nasal congestion, general weakness, and sometimes cough. In early September, Chinese researchers reported a newly identified tick-borne virus, ALTNV (Asian longhorned tick nairovirus), transmitted to humans by ticks. The infection generally resembles influenza, but co-infection with another dangerous virus can yield a more severe course. As of 2026-09-26, Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor says there are no ALTNV infections in Russia and recommends tick-bite prevention: wear light-colored, closed clothing with tight cuffs, apply repellents, and tuck pants into socks or shoes to deter ticks.

triage.headline_ja: ウクライナで新たな未知の感染症が発見される
triage.triage_reason: ウクライナで原因不明の感染症が報告され、中国由来のマダニ媒介ウイルス(ALTNV)との関連が示唆されているが、重症度や伝播様式など詳細情報が不足しており、続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウクライナで発生した原因不明の感染症であり、ロシア・中国は対象国リストに含まれない、または実際の発生地ではなく背景情報（研究報告）として言及されているのみのため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Nord-Kivu : 16 personnes guéries d'Ebola quittent les centres de traitement | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | North Kivu: 16 people recovered from Ebola leave treatment centers | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Sixteen people recovered from Ebola and left treatment centers in North Kivu, with a 17th person labeled non-cas e cleared. Twelve discharged from the Ebola Treatment Center in Katwa, Butembo, and five from Beni—four treated by International Medical Corps and one by MSF Holland. Among the survivors is a woman from a family heavily affected by Ebola, four relatives having died after the family initially suspected poisoning. Two infants are among the recovered, one accompanying a mother who also survived. Dr. Jérémie Katsavara stressed that rapid care at first symptoms is crucial. As of 26 September 2026, Nord-Kivu reports 1,402 confirmed Ebola cases and 850 deaths, with 16 of 34 health zones affected. Health officials urge people with suspected symptoms to seek care promptly to enable early management and limit transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：エボラ出血熱から回復した16人が治療センターを退所
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州で確認症例1,402人・死者850人に達する大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、34保健区域中16区域に拡大している深刻な公衆衛生事案であるため、IHR基準（重大な影響・異常性）を2つ満たしフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事は回復者の退所という前向きな内容だが、背景にある大規模かつ継続的なエボラ流行（1,402症例・850死亡、16/34保健区域）の深刻性からPICKUPと判断。国際NGO（International Medical Corps、MSF）の関与から国際支援が既に行われていることが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: 'When fear takes over': Responding to the DRC's largest Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ituri region hosts the largest Ebola outbreak on record in the country, now with at least 7,672 cumulative confirmed cases as of Sept 20 and 3,699 deaths; 2,703 of deaths occurred in Ituri, mortality 48.2%. As of Sept 10, 5,406 confirmed cases had been recorded in the current outbreak; daily cases have ranged 50–70. Transmission is driven by the rarer Bundibugyo Ebola virus, which delayed recognition because it did not appear on standard testing kits for weeks. Seven health zones have passed 42 days without new confirmed cases, and South Kivu is no longer among affected provinces; North Kivu remains impacted. Ituri's Bunia is the epicentre; Uganda’s earlier outbreak in neighboring country has been declared over (last patient discharged July 16). Children under five show fatality rates above 60%. Health workers stress psychosocial support to reduce fear and misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: 「恐怖が支配するとき」：DRC史上最大のエボラ流行への対応
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱流行が継続中で、致死率48%超、5歳未満は60%超と極めて深刻。国際的拡大リスクと社会的関心の高さから、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 隣国ウガンダの流行は既に終息宣言済み（7月16日に最終患者退院）。今回のDRC流行はイトゥリ州が中心で、稀なブンディブギョ株による診断遅延も課題。7つの保健地域では42日間新規感染なしと改善傾向も見られるが、依然として大規模流行継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Hong Kong officials investigate human infection of rat Hepatitis E virus
article.articleSummary: As of 26 September 2026, Hong Kong reports the third human infection of rat hepatitis E virus (rat HEV) this year. A 91-year-old man with underlying illnesses presented to Queen Elizabeth Hospital on 16 September with fever and weakness in four limbs; liver function was abnormal. His blood sample tested positive for rat HEV by the Public Health Laboratory Services Branch, CHP. Symptoms were relatively mild and he was discharged on 21 September after treatment. Rat HEV infections in humans mainly affect immunocompromised individuals; most cases are asymptomatic, while symptomatic patients may experience fatigue, abdominal pain and loss of appetite, with jaundice being less common. Transmission routes include ingestion of food or water contaminated by rodents or their excreta, exposure to contaminated environments/objects, and direct contact with rodents. Prevention emphasizes personal, food and environmental hygiene, the Five Keys to Food Safety, and rodent-control measures to reduce contact.

triage.headline_ja: 香港当局、ラット由来E型肝炎ウイルスのヒト感染事例を調査
triage.triage_reason: 免疫力の低下した高齢者における軽症のラットHEV散発例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、今年3例目として既知の監視体制下で管理されているため。
triage.notes: 人獣共通感染症であるラットHEVの散発症例。患者は91歳の基礎疾患を有する高齢者で、軽症のまま21日に退院。ヒト-ヒト感染の報告はなく、香港では今年既に2例の先行例があり監視体制下にある。

article.articleHeadline: الإمارات تخصص 10 ملايين دولار لمكافحة فيروس إيبولا في أفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UAE allocates $10 million to combat the Ebola virus in Africa.
article.articleSummary: UAE allocates $10 million through the UAE International Aid Agency to back international efforts to curb the Ebola outbreak in Africa and strengthen health-response capacity in affected areas. The announcement was made during UAE participation in a US-led international meeting on outbreak developments on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly, per WAM. The UAE has already sent more than 150 tons of aid and supplies—encompassing equipment, personal protective equipment, and infection-control materials—to affected regions, benefiting about 280 health facilities and providing shelter and food for those affected, including women and children. The move comes amid ongoing Ebola challenges in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with expanding geographic spread, underscoring the need for intensified international coordination and accelerated response actions.

triage.headline_ja: UAEがアフリカにおけるエボラウイルス対策のため1000万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが地理的に拡大しており、国際社会（UAE、米国主導の会合等）が支援を表明するなど社会的・政治的関心が高く、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCにおけるエボラアウトブレイクへの国際支援（UAEの資金拠出）。米国・UAEは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRC国内での地理的拡大が言及されているが、具体的な地域や感染者数などの詳細情報は本文からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: स्वाइन फ्लू भारी पड़ रही मरीज की अन्य बीमारियां
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu is taking a heavy toll on the patient's other illnesses.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) and scrub typhus dominated the UP APICON-2026 conference in Varanasi, held at Gokuldham, Rohaniya. Prof. G. Narasimulu cautioned that H1N1 typically resolves in healthy individuals, but comorbidity-bearing patients face higher risks of pneumonia, respiratory distress, and deterioration of existing illnesses, with very low overall mortality. Risk assessment should consider age, immunity, and pre-existing conditions; the elderly, young children, pregnant women, and those with chronic diseases are most vulnerable. Dr. Rajiv noted scrub typhus, once associated with forests, is now emerging in the general population; globally about one million people are infected each year, with initial symptoms resembling viral illness or dengue, potentially progressing to severe disease if treatment is delayed. Cardio-metabolic sessions addressed diabetes dietary myths, rare lipid disorders, ADA-guided use of semaglutide, and heart-failure management approaches.

triage.headline_ja: スワインフルーは患者の他の疾患に大きな打撃を与えている
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はバラナシで開催された医学会議（UP APICON-2026）における講演内容の報告であり、具体的な発生・症例数・アウトブレイクの情報は含まれていないため、シグナルとして扱う根拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事は医学会議での専門家講演内容（スワインフルーとツツガムシ病に関する一般的な医学教育情報）であり、実際の発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、地域検証の対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: Riposte contre Ebola : la RDC insiste sur une meilleure coordination de l'aide internationale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola response: the DRC insists on better coordination of international aid.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo demands better coordination of international aid in its Ebola response to Bundibugyo strain, during discussions in New York between Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka and CDC Director Dr. Erica Schwartz, with teams from Atlanta and the Congolese CDC country director Dr Delayo Zomahoun. The dialogue reaffirmed the CDC's two-decade partnership and its commitment to support Ebola mitigation while maintaining ongoing control of other health burdens such as measles, malaria, and tuberculosis. The Congolese government highlighted the need to recognize and value Congo's Ebola expertise, ensure transparent financial management, and strengthen national capacities within a collaborative framework. It called for improved traceability of funds and resources allocated by international partners. A videoconference upon Tuluka's return to Kinshasa with U.S. State Department, CDC, and Congolese experts was agreed to clarify divergences and bolster the Ebola response coordination.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応:コンゴ民主共和国、国際支援のより良い調整を要求
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続しており、国際的な対応調整が公式に議論されている重大な公衆衛生イベントであるため。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行そのものの新規報告ではなく、既存の流行対応における国際協力の調整に関する外交的内容。具体的な症例数・死亡者数の記載はないが、DRC政府とCDC・米国務省の高官級協議が行われており、社会的・政治的関心は高いと推察される。

article.articleHeadline: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザ、どんな感染症　押さえておきたいポイント：朝日新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza: What Kind of Infectious Disease Is It? Key Points to Keep in Mind — Asahi Shimbun
article.articleSummary: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) is an A-type influenza virus that primarily infects birds. Pathogenicity differs by poultry strain: low-pathogenic forms cause mild or no symptoms, while high-pathogenic forms trigger systemic illness and can wipe out flocks within days. The virus's surface is defined by two glycoproteins, hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA); to date, 18 HA subtypes and 11 NA subtypes have been identified, with combinations creating multiple subtypes, including H5N1, a representative high-pathogenic strain. H5N1 was first identified in 1996 in Guangdong Province, China. The article notes the worldwide spread of highly pathogenic avian influenza, with infections now seen in a range of mammalian species, underscoring cross-species transmission concerns. The piece emphasizes understanding these molecular features and subtypes to grasp ongoing outbreaks as of the published date, 2026-09-27.

triage.headline_ja: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザ、どんな感染症　押さえておきたいポイント：朝日新聞
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はHPAIの基礎知識を解説する一般的な教育記事であり、特定の現在進行中のアウトブレイクや新規感染事例を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は1996年に中国広東省でH5N1が最初に確認された旨の歴史的背景に触れているのみで、現在進行中の発生事例を報じるものではないため、地域を特定のイベント発生地として計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Hunger Hormone Receptor Emerges as Unexpected Lever Against Parasitic Liver
article.articleSummary: Cystic echinococcosis of the liver due to Echinococcus granulosus progressed more with ghrelin signaling. In Xinjiang, China, infected mice treated for 90 days showed that ghrelin administration raised serum ghrelin and hepatic ghrelin/GHSR, increased proliferation markers (Ki67, PCNA, Cyclin D1/E1), and suppressed the TGF-β1/Smad3 fibrotic pathway, reducing fibrosis proteins (α-SMA, Collagen I/III) and accelerating parasite growth. Blocking GHSR with the antagonist [D-Lys3]-GHRP-6 produced the opposite: lower ghrelin signaling, fewer proliferation signals, activation of TGF-β1/Smad3, higher fibrotic proteins, and a tighter fibrotic capsule around the cyst with slowed infection progression. Thus, fibrosis here acts as a containment wall, constraining the parasite. Ghrelin signaling emerges as a potential therapeutic target for a disease with limited drug options. Endemic in Central Asia, the Middle East, South America, and parts of China; Acta Parasitologica, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 空腹ホルモン受容体が寄生虫性肝疾患への予期せぬ介入点として浮上
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマウスを用いた基礎研究であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は動物実験による分子生物学的研究報告であり、実際のヒト・動物における嚢胞性エキノコックス症の発生事例やアウトブレイクを扱ったものではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: Hidden Viral Worlds and Antibiotic Resistance Genes Found in Colombian
article.articleSummary: Across seven Colombian sites in the Caribbean and Amazon, a metatranscriptomic survey of blood-feeding insects (Aedes, Culex, Psorophora, Coquillettidia, Lutzomyia, Psychodopygus) identified 416 viral sequences from 13 families in 23 RNA-seq libraries, dominated by insect-specific viruses rather than human pathogens. The researchers also mapped transcriptionally active bacterial microbiomes and antimicrobial resistance genes, confirming species by COI barcodes and using TPM normalization. Wolbachia appeared actively in Culex, Coquillettidia, and Aedes albopictus, underscoring its potential relevance for biocontrol. Low-abundance human-associated bacteria (Cutibacterium, Faecalibacterium, Prevotella, Hallela, Escherichia) likely reflect urban exposure and could serve as sentinels for environmental contamination and resistance gene flow. Virome composition varied markedly even among nearby pools, indicating ecological factors beyond host identity shape virus persistence. The findings stress the need for continuous, spatially distributed monitoring of vector microbiomes in dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and leishmaniasis burdened regions.

triage.headline_ja: コロンビアの蚊・サシチョウバエから未知のウイルス群と抗生物質耐性遺伝子が発見される
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はコロンビアの吸血昆虫を対象とした学術的なメタトランスクリプトーム調査であり、ヒトへの感染や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。対象国（コロンビア）もリスト外であり、ブラジルは主題ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はベクター（蚊・サシチョウバエ）のウイルス・微生物叢に関する基礎研究報告であり、実際のヒト感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。発生地域として挙がっているブラジル(Pará)は本文中で言及されておらず、主題国はコロンビアのみ（対象国リスト外）。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola corre verso nuovi confini: quasi 3.800 morti. E se arrivasse in Europa?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola races toward new frontiers: nearly 3,800 deaths. What if it reached Europe?
article.articleSummary: WHO’s latest update on Ebola caused by Bundibugyo virus shows the Democratic Republic of the Congo grappling with an outbreak: as of Sept. 23 there are 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths (about 48% fatality). The epidemic has spread to 63 health zones across seven provinces, with Sud Ubangi affected and Dungu in Haut-Uele near the South Sudan border, raising cross-border transmission risk. Unlike Ebola Zaire, there are no approved vaccines or antivirals for Bundibugyo; candidate therapies exist in trials, but tools against Zaire Ebola cannot be assumed effective here. In Europe, the risk to the general population remains very low, though nonzero, because some cases have arrived via evacuations. ECDC has hospital checklists for rapid case recognition, isolation, PPE, labs, contact tracing, and safe patient transport. The core issue for healthcare systems: how quickly could a single suspected case be identified and contained at first contact, not in ICU.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、新たな国境へ拡大:死者数約3,800人に。もし欧州に到達したら?
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる大規模流行(致死率約48%)が7州63保健地区に拡大し、南スーダン国境付近にも及んでいることから、IHR基準の複数項目に該当しPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによるDRCでの大規模流行を報告。ワクチン・抗ウイルス薬が未承認である点、南スーダン国境近接地域(Dungu)への拡大が越境リスクを高めている点が重要。欧州への直接的リスクは低いとされるが、記事の主眼はDRCでの流行状況。Sudan(366755)は発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに該当しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Pocah se declara a Arthur Pelágio após namorado cuidar de sua mãe com chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pocah declares her love to Arthur Pelágio after her boyfriend took care of his mother with chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: On September 26, 2026, Brazilian singer Pocah revealed on social media that her mother contracted chikungunya and needed care. Despite a demanding schedule—new project, concerts, endorsements, and exams—Pocah said she had to juggle responsibilities to look after her mother. She praised her boyfriend, Arthur Pelágio, for staying by their side, spending nights at the hospital, continuing to work without sleep, and providing emotional support and smiles during tense moments. The post underscores personal resilience and partner support amid illness, with no details on laboratory confirmation, infection source, or geographic spread. The report centers on familial strain and the caring role of a partner during a chikungunya infection, rather than epidemiology or public health response.

triage.headline_ja: ポカ、恋人アルトゥール・ペラジオが母親のチクングニア熱看病を経て交際宣言
triage.triage_reason: 有名人の個人的な家族エピソードであり、公衆衛生上の情報（検査確認・感染源・地理的拡大等）が一切含まれない単発の個人症例報道のため。
triage.notes: 芸能ニュース記事であり、疫学的情報（発生状況、感染源、地域拡大等）が皆無のため公衆衛生シグナルとして扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand Floods Spark Disease Warnings By Health Experts
article.articleSummary: Thailand faces a second wave of health threats as severe monsoon floods in Bangkok and across the country leave pools of stagnant water. The Department of Disease Control warns of waterborne and mosquito-borne illnesses, urging early detection. Leptospirosis, linked to floodwater contaminated with urine from rats and stray dogs, poses the most dangerous risk; symptoms include sudden high fever, severe calf and muscle pain, appearing 7–14 days after exposure, with possible kidney or liver damage if untreated. Prolonged contact with dirty water can cause skin infections and a condition called 'water biting feet' due to fungal infections. Dengue fever, driven by Aedes mosquitoes breeding in small puddles, is expected to surge as floods recede. Prevention focuses on hygiene, washing after contact with floodwaters, drying skin, wearing rubber boots, and eliminating standing water. No case counts provided.

triage.headline_ja: タイの洪水、専門家が感染症警報を発令
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症・デング熱リスクに関する注意喚起だが、具体的な症例数や規模の情報がなく、季節性・予防的警告の域を出ないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 症例数の記載がなく、洪水後の季節性感染症に関する予防的警告記事。実際の患者発生状況の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: NCDC's fresh alarm on Ebola
article.articleSummary: Nigeria’s NCDC raises fresh alarm over Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) amid worsening Bundibugyo EVD cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). ECDC data show DRC with 7,672 confirmed cases and 3,699 deaths as of Sept 20, with Ituri Province accounting for 5,913 cases and 2,703 deaths across 28 of 36 health zones; 886 hospitalised and 1,879 recovered. In response, Nigeria requires travelers from affected countries to complete the Nigeria Health Declaration Form, including travel history, symptoms and exposure; passengers from other countries are exempt for now. Border surveillance and preparedness are stepped up, per advisory signed by NCDC Director-General Dr. Jide Idris after consultations with the Ministry of Health, Port Health Services, FAAN, NCAA, NIS, and other partners, with WHO and Africa CDC providing support. Measures will be reviewed as the epidemiology evolves, and non-pharmaceutical precautions are urged to prevent importation, recalling the 2014 Lagos importation via Patrick Sawyer.

triage.headline_ja: NCDC、エボラ出血熱に対する新たな警戒を発令
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行が拡大し死者3,699人・症例7,672件に達しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC（特にIturi州）でのエボラ流行であり、ナイジェリアは輸入例を警戒し渡航者への健康申告義務化などの予防措置を講じているのみで、ナイジェリア国内での感染確認は報告されていない。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Sebanyak 24 Kasus Influenza A Terdeteksi di Wilayah DIY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A total of 24 Influenza A cases detected in the Yogyakarta Special Region.
article.articleSummary: Twenty-four laboratory-confirmed Influenza A cases were detected in the Special Region of Yogyakarta (DIY), Indonesia, through sentinel-lab testing in designated hospitals as of Friday, 25 September 2026. Of these, 11 are H1N1pdm09 and 11 are H3N2, with 2 cases not yet subtyped. Influenza A activity is described as part of Indonesia’s year-round seasonal cycle; common symptoms include fever, cough, and sore throat. Despite these confirmations, DIY Health Office notes no week-to-week rise in Influenza A, and ISPA (Acute Respiratory Infection) rates are reportedly trending downward over the past four weeks. Subtyping is constrained by laboratory capacity, limiting detailed typing to sentinel facilities, while other facilities report ISPA without subtype data. Regional authorities, in collaboration with the Ministry of Health, are maintaining epidemiologic surveillance. Prevention guidance emphasizes PHBS (Healthy Living and Sanitation Behaviors), handwashing with soap and running water, and cough etiquette, including masking when ill.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア・ジョグジャカルタ特別州でインフルエンザA型24例を検出
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内の検出であり、当局も週間増加なしと報告。重症例や異常性の報告もなく、社会的関心も低い。
triage.notes: H1N1pdm09とH3N2の季節性株混在で、地域保健当局は増加傾向なしと明言。ISPA発生率も減少傾向にあり、通常のサーベイランス範囲内の事象。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة وفيات "إيبولا" في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 3833 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 3,833.
article.articleSummary: On 27 September 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ministry of Health reported that the Ebola outbreak has reached 7,946 confirmed infections and 3,833 deaths, with a case fatality rate of 48.2% among confirmed cases as of 24 September. The figures, issued from Kinshasa, reflect the ongoing, severe burden of Ebola across the country. The high CFR underscores the continued severity of the outbreak in the DRC, though the report does not specify geographic distribution within the country, affected provinces, or health interventions in place. No information on imported or exported cases is provided. The data indicate persistent transmission through late September, signaling the need for sustained surveillance, isolation, and supportive care measures to reduce mortality.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱による死者数が3,833人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: 感染者7,946人・死亡3,833人（CFR48.2%）と規模が大きく、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大の懸念からIHR基準に複数該当するため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: 既知の大規模エボラ流行の続報。地理的分布や介入措置の詳細は記載なく、今後の続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة وفيات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 3833 حالة - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 3,833.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, with 7,946 confirmed infections and 3,833 deaths reported by the Ministry of Health. As of September 24, 2026, the case fatality rate among confirmed cases is 48.2%. The figures were announced from Kinshasa on September 27, 2026, and reflect confirmed infections up to September 24, indicating ongoing transmission and a high mortality burden. The report provides no further details on infection sources, geographic breakdown within the DRC, or laboratory confirmation methods.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数、3,833人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: 確認感染者7,946人、致死率48.2%と極めて深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、継続的な人的被害と国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 感染源や地理的分布、検査方法についての詳細情報が不足しているため、続報でのフォローが必要。致死率48.2%は非常に高く、継続的な感染拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarampo disparam e São Paulo tem 37 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases surge and São Paulo has 37 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 September 2026, São Paulo state in Brazil reports 37 measles cases, a sharp rise from 2 cases the previous year, with 33 cases in the city of São Paulo. Measles is a highly contagious viral infection transmitted via airborne spread. Common symptoms include high fever, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, and a characteristic red rash on the skin. The most recently confirmed case is a 42-year-old man with no vaccination history. Of the 37 patients, 27 were unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. Vaccination is provided free through the public health system and is recommended from six months of age; maintaining vaccination schedules is key to curbing outbreaks. Health authorities report that, since intensifying outreach, more than 2 million doses have been administered, underscoring the need for adults to vaccinate to interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹症例が急増、サンパウロ州で37例
triage.triage_reason: 前年2例から37例へ急増しており、未接種者が多数を占めるなど流行しやすい状況で、当局が大規模なワクチン接種キャンペーンを展開するなど社会的・行政的関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州・市における麻疹症例の急増（前年比大幅増）で、未接種者が多くを占める。死亡例や重症度の詳細は記事に記載なし。当局はワクチン接種キャンペーンを強化中。

article.articleHeadline: BKSDA Maluku perkuat deteksi dini penyakit zoonosis pada satwa liar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maluku BKSDA strengthens early detection of zoonotic diseases in wildlife.
article.articleSummary: Maluku's Balai Konservasi Sumber Daya Alam (BKSDA) strengthens early detection of zoonotic diseases and emerging infectious diseases in wildlife by boosting information systems and cross-sector coordination. In Ambon, on 26 September, Polhut BKSDA Maluku Nur Arfa Lating said the move is part of BKSDA Maluku's participation in the SIZE Workshop on Zoonosis Information Systems and Emerging Infectious Diseases (Regional Central-Eastern) held in West Java. The integrated system consolidates data from the Early Warning and Response System (SKDR), the National Animal Health Information System (ISIKHNAS), and the SehatSatli platform to support monitoring of diseases in humans, domestic animals, and wildlife. This One Health approach strengthens collaboration among human health, animal health, and wildlife health sectors, enabling more coordinated detection, reporting, and rapid response to zoonoses and new infections tied to wildlife and conservation ecosystems, and helps prevent spillover to humans.

triage.headline_ja: マルク州BKSDA、野生動物における人獣共通感染症の早期探知を強化
triage.triage_reason: 実際の疾病発生報告ではなく、監視体制強化に関する行政的取り組みの記事であり、具体的な健康被害事例は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な感染症アウトブレイクではなく、One Healthアプローチによる監視システム強化のワークショップ参加を報じたもの。実際の疾病名・症例数・地域情報が不明確なため、対象国リストへの該当なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: عاجل| تحذيرات من تفشي سلالة جديدة من فيروس كورونا.. فما القصة؟ - الوطن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking: Warnings of an outbreak of a new coronavirus strain… what's the story? - Al-Watan
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-27, British experts warned of a new coronavirus strain found in bats with high potential to spread to humans. The Daily Star reports the mysterious strain shares the FCS site on spike proteins with SARS-CoV-2, the cause of COVID-19, and has been detected in a Brazilian coronavirus lineage dubbed HKU5-CoV-2. Laboratory tests suggest the new virus can infect human lungs and intestines in a manner similar to COVID-19. Dr. Gareth Nye of the University of Salford cautions the virus is currently far less efficient than SARS-CoV-2, so the immediate direct risk is low. Nevertheless, the potential for animal-to-human transmission exists, given its ability to bind to multiple mammal species and to mutate toward human adaptation. There are no known human cases yet; researchers worldwide are actively monitoring to prevent spillover, as in the COVID-19 outbreak about six years ago.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：新型コロナウイルスの新株流行への警告…その真相は？ - アル・ワタン
triage.triage_reason: コウモリ由来の新規コロナウイルス系統がブラジルで検出され、人への感染ポテンシャルが指摘されているが、ヒト感染例は確認されておらず専門家も直接的リスクは低いとしており、続報を注視すべき段階。
triage.notes: 記事は動物(コウモリ)由来の新規コロナウイルス系統に関する警告であり、ヒト感染例は現時点で報告されていない。ブラジルの系統(HKU5-CoV-2)への言及があるためBrazilを含めたが、英国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。専門家は現時点でのリスクは低いと評価している。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus ISPA Capai 11.710, Dinkes Pamekasan Belum Temukan Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acute Respiratory Infection cases reach 11,710; Pamekasan Health Office has not yet detected Influenza A.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A has not been detected in Pamekasan Regency, East Java, as of Sep 27, 2026, despite 11,710 acute respiratory infection (ARI) cases reported from January–August 2026. The Pamekasan Health Office (Dinkes) reports no suspected influenza A cases detected to date. In response to rising influenza activity in parts of Java, the Health Office has intensified surveillance across the regional general hospital (RSUD), community health centers (puskesmas), and other health facilities, demanding reports from all facilities and tightening screening for flu-like symptoms. ARI cases are rising due to hot, dry season conditions, with rapid respiratory transmission. Most cases affect children, including toddlers. Officials urge the public to seek care promptly for cough, flu, fever, or runny nose, to wear masks, and to protect vulnerable groups while surveillance continues to monitor for potential influenza A introductions.

triage.headline_ja: ISPA(急性呼吸器感染症)症例が11,710件に到達、パメカサン保健局はインフルエンザAを未検出
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザAは検出されておらず、季節性のARI増加のみで、異常性・重大性・国際的拡大リスクいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はインフルエンザAが検出されていないことを報告しており、季節性ARI増加への注意喚起に過ぎない。地域保健局によるサーベイランス強化のみで国際的関心事項ではない。
