article.articleHeadline: देहरादून में स्वाइन फ्लू के 15 नए मरीज, कुल संक्रमित 641; डेंगू और कोविड के भी केस मिले - 15 new swine flu cases total number of infected reaches 641
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 15 new swine flu cases in Dehradun; total infected 641; dengue and COVID-19 cases also reported.
article.articleSummary: Dehradun district reports 15 new H1N1 (swine flu) cases from 80 tested samples, bringing the state’s total H1N1 infections to 641 (Dehradun 428; other districts 213). Currently 39 patients are hospitalized; 600 have recovered; 2 deaths recorded after death audit. Of the 641 cases, 339 are male and 302 female. Separately, one new COVID-19 case was detected among 1,060 samples tested, with 57 total infections (Dehradun 29; other districts 28) and 56 recoveries. Dengue reports two new cases in Dehradun from 45 samples; overall dengue cases rise to 222 (Dehradun 109; other districts 113); currently 19 hospitalized and 203 have recovered. No details on infection sources or imported/exported cases are provided. Data valid as of 26 September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: デヘラードゥーンでスワインフルー新規15例、感染者累計641人；デング熱・COVID-19の症例も確認
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1・デング熱・COVID-19に関する定例統計報告であり、新規性・異常性は認められず、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも記載されていない。
triage.notes: H1N1、COVID-19、デング熱いずれも既知の季節性疾患で、地域の保健当局による定例の症例数更新報告。死亡2例・入院39例のH1N1は中等度だが、記事全体は継続的な流行状況の推移報告であり、新規の懸念事項は確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: TP Hồ Chí Minh cảnh báo nguy cơ phơi nhiễm bệnh dại gia tăng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City warns of increasing rabies exposure risk.
article.articleSummary: From the start of 2026 through Sept 26, 2026, Ho Chi Minh City recorded 6 rabies deaths and 101,000 animal bite/crawl incidents involving dogs and cats. Deaths occurred in Cu Chi, Hoa Hiep and Long Hai communes; all decedents reportedly did not receive post-exposure vaccination or rabies immunoglobulin, with reasons including underestimating wounds or reliance on folk remedies. Overall exposure risk remains high, with 101,384 bite/crawl cases, up 11.2% year on year; 12,560 involved animals displaying abnormal behavior (loose, missing, ill or suspected rabies). In Long Hai, 128 residents reported dogs suspected of rabies bite. The city operates 202 rabies vaccination points (53 public, 18 immunoglobulin sites). World Rabies Prevention Day on Sept 28, 2026 promotes One Health coordination; recommendations urge annual vaccination of dogs and cats, leashing, immediate wound washing with soap under running water for at least 15 minutes, and seeking medical care; avoid unverified traditional remedies.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市、狂犬病曝露リスクの増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡例が報告されているが、国内の風土病でありIHR基準の国際拡大・渡航貿易制限には該当しない。地域の公衆衛生対応は既存の枠組み内で管理されており、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はホーチミン市（ベトナム）における狂犬病曝露事例の増加を報告する地方保健当局の注意喚起であり、World Rabies Dayに合わせた予防啓発が主旨。中国（Henan/Longhai）は地名データに含まれるが記事本文では言及されておらず、除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Child rights panel seeks report on measles deaths in Keralam's Malappuram
article.articleSummary: Two children died of measles in Malappuram district, Kerala, prompting a suo motu case by the Kerala State Commission for Protection of Child Rights. The victims are a 10-month-old from Valavannur near Kottakkal and an 18-month-old from Ponmala near Malappuram. Reports due in 15 days will examine whether vaccination was timely and any lapses, and identify groups reluctant to vaccinate. Health department data show about one-third of Malappuram children have not completed both measles vaccine doses in three years; 2025-26 saw only 63% with both doses. More than 40% of children in Vengara, Tanur, Malappuram, Areekode block panchayats lack full vaccination. In 2026, Malappuram logged 63 confirmed measles cases; roughly 400 symptomatic individuals are under observation. Symptoms include fever, cold, red eyes, and skin rashes; severe cases risk pneumonia and encephalitis. Authorities have issued an alert and intensified vaccination drives in Valavannur, Kuttippuram, Vengara, and Pookkottur.

triage.headline_ja: 子供の権利委員会、ケーララ州マラップラムでの麻疹死亡例に関する報告を要求
triage.triage_reason: ケーララ州マラップラムで麻疹による小児死亡2例が発生し、63例の確定例と約400例の症候性観察例があり、地域のワクチン接種率も低いため流行の可能性がある。児童権利委員会が調査を開始し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域はインド・ケーララ州マラップラム県に限定。ワクチン接種率の低さ（一部地域で40%超が未接種）が流行拡大の懸念材料。国際的拡大の証拠はないが、児童死亡と低ワクチン接種率から国内的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: மிரட்டுது டெங்கு.. மேற்கு மண்டலத்தில் வேகமாகப் பரவும் டெங்கு காய்ச்சல்! காஞ்சிபுரத்திலும் அதிகமாம்!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue is frightening.. Dengue fever spreading rapidly in the Western region! Even more in Kanchipuram!
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is spreading rapidly in Tamil Nadu’s Western region, with Thanjavur and Kanchipuram among the hotspots. In Thanjavur, four dengue patients have been admitted to Thanjavur Medical College Hospital, which has set up a 25-bed dengue ward. Government Raja Mirasudhar Hospital is also involved in surveillance and care. Tamil Nadu’s Director of Medical Education, Lokanayaki, urged calm, noting that about 80% of viral fevers recover spontaneously with monitoring. She highlighted ongoing transmission in the Western region. All dengue cases reported in the state are recovering, with no fatalities mentioned. Staffing gaps persist for nurses and nursing assistants, with announcements expected within a week. In parallel, the Tamil Nadu government announced budget measures increasing medical education capacity: D Pharma to B Pharmacy with 60 extra seats; Nursing college seats rising from 100 to 150; allied medical seats up to 60; and efforts to start BSc and MSc Psychology programs.

triage.headline_ja: デングは恐ろしい…西部地域で急速に広がるデング熱！カーンチープラムでも増加！
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州西部でデング熱が拡大しているが、死亡例なく当局は落ち着きを呼びかけており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的拡大の兆候は不明確なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱は当該地域で毎年流行する疾患であり、季節的な増加とみられる。死亡例の報告はなく、当局は医療体制強化で対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Ho Chi Minh City reports rise in rabies deaths amid increase in animal bite exposures
article.articleSummary: Rabies deaths in Ho Chi Minh City total six since the start of 2026, two more than the same period in 2025, with an 11.2% rise in animal-exposure reports. Deaths occurred in Cu Chi, Hoa Hiep, and Long Hai communes. Health facilities have logged 101,384 bite or scratch cases from dogs, cats, and other domestic animals through 2026, including 12,560 with unusual signs suggestive of rabies; Long Hai surveillance alone recorded 128 reports of dogs suspected of carrying rabies. None of the deceased had received rabies vaccine or antiserum post-exposure. Authorities cite risk underestimation and use of traditional remedies. Response includes 202 rabies vaccination sites (53 public) and 18 sites with antiserum, plus One Health collaboration with agriculture and local authorities. A Sept 28 citywide rally and online discussions aim to boost prevention. Immediate wound care and vaccination/antiserum remain critical.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市、動物咬傷曝露の増加に伴い狂犬病による死亡者数が増加と報告
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病はベトナムで既知の風土病であり国際的拡大やヒト-ヒト感染のリスクはないが、咬傷曝露件数増加や予防接種未実施での死亡例が続いており、公衆衛生上の懸念として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムで風土病として継続的に発生しており、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大の懸念はない。ただし咬傷曝露件数の増加と予防接種未実施での死亡例が続いている点は地域の公衆衛生対応として注視が必要。中国関連の地域情報（Henan省等）はサマリー内容と無関係のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Two measles deaths in a week, vaccination gaps in Kerala's Malappuram raise concerns
article.articleSummary: As of 27 September 2026, Malappuram district in Kerala reports 103 confirmed measles cases, with outbreaks centered in Valavannur, Kuttippuram, Vengara and Pookkottur. Two children died within a week: a 10-month-old from Valavannur died on 15 September, and the latest a 1.5-year-old child died on a Wednesday. The Kerala State Commission for Protection of Child Rights has intervened, requesting reports and urging authorities to identify children who may have been missed by the measles vaccination programme. Vaccination gaps persist for two-dose MR: nearly one-third of children have not received both doses in each of the past three years, and the district has not met the 95% coverage target. First-dose coverage was 91% in 2021-22; second-dose coverage was 79% (2021-22), 81% (2022-23), 63% (2023-24), 61% (2024-25), and 63% (2025-26).

triage.headline_ja: 1週間で麻疹による死亡2例、ケララ州マラプラムでワクチン接種の格差が懸念を呼ぶ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち重大な公衆衛生影響（小児2名の死亡）と異常性（ワクチン未接種児童の存在）の2つが該当し、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断される。
triage.notes: ケララ州マラプラム県で103例の確認麻疹症例、うち生後10ヶ月と1歳半の児童2名が1週間以内に死亡。過去3年間、2回目MRワクチン接種率が61〜81%で推移し95%目標未達。地域限定の流行だが、ワクチン接種格差が続く限り感染拡大リスクは継続する。

article.articleHeadline: น้ำท่วม ระวัง! 3 ภัยใกล้ตัว 6 กลุ่มโรค บางโรคมีอาการหลังลุยน้ำ 1-2 สัปดาห์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Floods: Beware! Three immediate hazards, six disease groups; some diseases show symptoms 1–2 weeks after wading through floodwater.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-27, Thailand's floods pose three immediate hazards: drowning in fast currents or unseen depths (children especially); electric shock from water contacting electrical systems; and entry of venomous reptiles (snakes, centipedes, scorpions) into homes. Avoid barefoot travel, secure wounds, use tools to reach victims, cut power safely, and call 1669 for emergencies. Six flood-related disease groups to watch: Leptospirosis (Weil’s disease) from water/soil contaminated with urine, with fever, headache, myalgia, possible kidney or liver failure; skin infections from prolonged water contact; diarrheal and foodborne illness from contaminated food and water; mosquito-borne diseases; conjunctivitis; and respiratory infections from humidity and dust. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, eye irritation, cough. Prevent dehydration with oral rehydration salts; seek urgent care for severe symptoms. Precautions: wear boots, cover wounds, hand hygiene, cooked food and clean water, eliminate standing water, keep medications dry; report hazards to authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水に注意！身近な3つの危険と6つの疾患群、一部は浸水後1〜2週間で症状が出る
triage.triage_reason: 洪水に伴う一般的な健康被害の注意喚起記事であり、レプトスピラ症を含む複数疾患群への一般的注意喚起にとどまり、具体的な患者数や集団発生の報告はないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 洪水による公衆衛生一般啓発記事であり、レプトスピラ症の実際の症例数や発生状況の具体的データは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو يصل إلى منطقتين صحيتين جديدتين
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches two new health zones.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has expanded to two new health zones: Bolo in South Ubangi near the Central African Republic border, and Dongo in Ituri near the border with South Sudan. The outbreak now spans 63 health zones across seven provinces. As of 23 September, 7,890 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths have been reported, indicating a still-high fatality rate. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cautioned that armed conflict and population displacement impede response efforts, hindering contact tracing and safe‑burial practices, though progress in community engagement and tracing has been noted. Overall case numbers are declining, but transmission remains uneven across regions. There is no vaccine or approved treatment yet for the Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak; WHO is accelerating clinical trials for vaccines and therapeutics. Ituri remains the main hotspot with over 6,000 cases; North Kivu is the second most affected.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が新たに2つの保健地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行が継続中で、致死率が高く、新規保健地域への拡大や国境地域での懸念が見られるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はCARおよび南スーダン国境付近への拡大を報告しているが、実際の症例発生国はDRCのみであり、CARおよびSudanは対象国リストにも含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Cả nước có 55 người tử vong vì bệnh dại trong 9 tháng đầu năm 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There were 55 rabies deaths nationwide in the first nine months of 2026.
article.articleSummary: In the first nine months of 2026, Vietnam recorded 55 rabies deaths nationwide, with 2025 reporting 77 fatalities; over 1 million people received post-exposure vaccination, signaling ongoing exposure risk. On September 26 in Dak Lak province, the Ministry of Health and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development, alongside the Dak Lak People’s Committee, organized a World Rabies Day ceremony and a national interagency drill to test multi-sector response to a dog suspected of rabies biting a person. The simulated scenario requires coordination from information intake and investigation to animal handling and guidance on wound care and post-exposure prophylaxis. Rabies remains nearly always fatal after symptom onset but is preventable with proper wound care and timely vaccination. Dogs and cats are the main sources; vaccination and responsible pet management reduce human cases. After a bite: wash the wound with soap and water for about 15 minutes, seek medical care, and follow professional advice; do not rely on home remedies or watchful waiting.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年最初の9ヶ月間で全国55人が狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで毎年報告される狂犬病による死亡例であり、既知の風土病の年次統計・世界狂犬病デー関連報道であるため異常性は低いが、継続的な曝露リスクと政府機関の対応強化の動きがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムで毎年発生する風土病であり、本記事は世界狂犬病デーに合わせた年次統計報告および省庁間訓練の報道。新規の異常発生ではないが、継続的なヒトへの曝露リスク（年間100万人以上の暴露後ワクチン接種）が示されている点は留意すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 1,534 city schools cleared of waste in anti-dengue drive
article.articleSummary: Dengue and fever prevention drive across Chennai's city targeted 1,534 educational institutions under the Greater Chennai Corporation across all 15 zones, including 635 government/Corporation-run and 899 private schools, on Saturday. A total of 3,214 workers were deployed to identify and eliminate mosquito breeding sites on school premises. The operation cleared 8,351 kg of unwanted materials and discarded tyres from the campuses; specifically, 7,419 kg of materials that could hold stagnant water and 932 kg of tyres. To deter vectors, 262 fogging and larvicidal spraying machines were deployed across the campuses as part of preventive measures against dengue.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策活動で市内1,534校の廃棄物を撤去
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の日常的な予防活動（清掃・防除）に関する報道であり、症例急増や異常事態を示す情報がなく、通常の公衆衛生対策の一環と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はチェンナイ市当局によるデング熱予防（蚊の繁殖地除去）活動の実施報告であり、感染急増や症例数についての言及はない。定例的な公衆衛生活動と判断しDISMISSとした。

article.articleHeadline: Kampanye di CFD, PMI Sebut DBD Musuh Bersama dan Wabah Mengkhawatirkan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campaign on Car-Free Day, PMI Calls Dengue Fever a Common Enemy and a Worrisome Outbreak
article.articleSummary: On 27 September 2026, Jakarta's PMI DKI Chairman Beky Mardani framed dengue fever (DBD) as a common enemy during a Car-Free Day campaign at Bundaran HI, Jakarta. The event, co-hosted with the DKI Jakarta Health Department, featured a giant mosquito larva mascot and interactive activities to educate residents that dengue remains an alarming outbreak. Jakarta's West, South, and East districts were highlighted as high-risk areas due to soil conditions and standing water that promote Aedes breeding. The campaign promotes 3M Plus measures for vector control: emptying water storage, covering containers, and repurposing items likely to collect water. MDPP education has reached 178,358 people across Balekambang and Pekayon (East Jakarta) and Pengadegan and Pejaten Timur (South Jakarta). The initiative uses the motto 'One House, One Jumantik, Zero Larvae' and involves Dinas Kesehatan and partners.

triage.headline_ja: CFD(カーフリーデー)でのキャンペーン、インドネシア赤十字社(PMI)がデング熱を「共通の敵」であり「懸念すべき流行」と表明
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の啓発・予防キャンペーンに関する記事であり、新規の異常な発生や重症例急増の報告はなく、既存の公衆衛生対策活動の紹介にとどまる。
triage.notes: 記事はジャカルタにおける既存のデング熱対策啓発キャンペーンの報道であり、具体的な症例数・死亡者数・急増などの定量的情報は含まれていない。デング熱は同地域で季節的に流行しやすい感染症であるため、WPRO基準の一部(長期曝露・流行しやすさ)は該当するが、緊急性を示す新規情報はなくDISMISS判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: 9月28日世界狂犬病日，中疾控提醒：蝙蝠等动物也能传播狂犬病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Rabies Day on September 28: China CDC reminds that bats and other animals can also transmit rabies
article.articleSummary: World Rabies Day (Sept 28) highlights a April 2026 event in Jining, Shandong, China, where a cat that bit and scratched two people tested positive for rabies virus in brain and saliva samples. Both patients received timely, standardized post-exposure care and completed the full vaccination course, with no symptoms to date. Viral genome sequencing showed the cat’s virus highly homologous to a canine strain, suggesting dog-to-cat transmission prior to human exposure. In China, about 5% of rabies cases arise from cat bites or scratches. The China CDC emphasizes rabies as a zoonotic disease with near 100% fatality once symptoms appear, yet prevention via vaccination and prompt post-exposure prophylaxis is highly effective. Public guidance: vaccinate dogs and cats annually, seek immediate medical care after bites or scratches, and complete prescribed prophylaxis. Note: bats can transmit rabies; avoid handling them.

triage.headline_ja: 9月28日世界狂犬病デー：中国疾病予防コントロールセンターがコウモリなど動物も狂犬病を媒介すると注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 個別事例（猫による咬傷、適切な曝露後予防で無症状）を用いた世界狂犬病デーの啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常な拡大や新規性はなく、IHR・WPRO基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は世界狂犬病デーに合わせた啓発・教育目的の報道であり、感染拡大や異常事態を示すものではない。狂犬病自体は既知の風土病でヒト-ヒト感染はしない。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية.. ارتفاع حصيلة وفيات "إيبولا" إلى 3833 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo... Ebola death toll rises to 3,833.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reached 7,946, with 3,833 deaths, as of 24 September 2026. The Ministry of Health reported a case fatality rate of 48.2% among confirmed infections. The data illustrate the ongoing, high-lethality Ebola outbreak in the DRC, with nearly half of identified cases resulting in death. The figures are current to late September 2026 and reflect the latest official tallies. The report does not provide additional details on geographic hotspots, transmission chains, or infection sources beyond the confirmed counts. This update underscores the ongoing public health challenge posed by Ebola in the DRC and the need for sustained intervention.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国…エボラによる死者数が3,833人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例7,946人・死亡3,833人（致死率48.2%）という大規模かつ致死性の高いエボラ流行が継続しており、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるため。
triage.notes: 感染源や地理的ホットスポットの詳細は記事に記載されておらず不明。致死率48.2%と非常に高く、継続的な国際支援が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: தமிழகத்தில் மேற்கு மண்டலத்தில் டெங்கு அதிகம்... தஞ்சையில் 4 பேர் பாதிப்பு: மருத்துவக் கல்வி இயக்குநர் தகவல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases high in the Western region of Tamil Nadu... Four people infected in Thanjavur: Director of Medical Education says.
article.articleSummary: Four dengue fever patients are admitted at Thanjavur Medical College Hospital, with a dedicated 25-bed dengue ward established as Tamil Nadu’s Western region reports higher dengue activity. Director of Medical Education (on deputation) V. Lokanayaki inspected Thanjavur Medical College Hospital and Government Raja Mirasudhar Hospital, outlining dengue-focused arrangements and fever-management protocols. She noted rising dengue cases in the Western region and in Kanchipuram. Public reassurance: there is no need to panic; about 80% of viral fevers recover spontaneously, but fever cases should remain under medical supervision and be tested for dengue if symptoms arise. Staffing updates: nursing and nursing aide vacancies are being filled within a week. Education expansion: Thanjavur Medical College’s medical admissions are being increased; D.Pharm upgraded to B.Pharm; Nursing seats rise from 100 to 150; allied-health seats expanded to 60; new BSc and MSc Psychology programs being planned.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州西部地域でデング熱が増加…タンジャーヴールで4人感染:医学教育局長が発表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱の局地的増加であり、通常の医療対応（専用病棟設置等）で管理可能とされているが、地域拡大の継続報告があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地域当局が既に病床確保・人員配置等で対応しており、重症例や死亡の報告はない。季節性の流行パターンとみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Athorities issue dengue alert for Arunachal capital as fever cases rise
article.articleSummary: Arunachal Pradesh's capital Itanagar issued a dengue health advisory as fever cases rise, signaling an upsurge of sudden short-term fever. The Itanagar Capital Region District Medical Officer, Dr C Lowang Mallo, urged early detection and public awareness. Dengue is a vector-borne illness causing acute febrile illness typically lasting two to seven days, with symptoms including headache, body and joint pain, rashes, and retro-orbital pain behind the eyes. Preventive measures focus on mosquito control: eliminate stagnant water, regularly clean water coolers and tanks, keep storage containers covered, use repellents and nets, install window screens, and wear full-sleeved clothing. Those with dengue symptoms should not self-medicate; seek a doctor promptly for diagnosis. Avoid aspirin, ibuprofen, and steroids unless advised by a clinician.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱症例増加によりアルナーチャル・プラデーシュ州都でデング熱警報発令
triage.triage_reason: 地方自治体によるデング熱の季節性増加に対する注意喚起であり、異常性や重篤性、国際的拡大の情報はないが、ベクター媒介感染症として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 地方の医療当局による季節性デング熱の注意喚起であり、症例数・重症度の詳細データは記事に記載なし。地域限定の公衆衛生対応であり、国際的な懸念は現時点で低い。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah TBC Meluas, Cirebon Perluas Tracing Hingga 412 Desa |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent TB from Spreading, Cirebon Expands Tracing Up to 412 Villages | Republika Online
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) tracing in Cirebon Regency, Indonesia, is expanding to 412 villages under a free health-check program. By the third week of September 2026, Health Office staff had surveyed 340 of 412 villages. The integrated tracing targets contacts of TB patients, those with cough, and individuals with risk factors. Since early August, about 34,000 people in 340 villages were screened; of roughly 18,000 records entered, around 2,200 were categorized as suspected TB, with 74 confirmed positive and started on treatment. Family household members of patients (234) have also received treatment; tracing was extended around residences to identify additional transmission. The plan aims to screen 46,600 people (about 100 per village) through November 2026, using free screenings and mobile X-ray units. Nationwide TB control targets by 2030 seek a 50% reduction versus 2025, not zero cases.

triage.headline_ja: 結核の蔓延を防ぐため、チレボンが追跡調査を412村まで拡大
triage.triage_reason: 結核はインドネシアの流行病であり、本記事は定例の追跡・スクリーニングプログラムの進捗報告であって、異常な集団発生や急激な公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事は自治体の定例検診・追跡活動の報告。国レベルの目標（2030年までに50%削減）に沿った通常業務であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Unde se ascund virusurile după ce se încheie o epidemie? Misterul rezervorului natural al unuia din cele mai letale virusuri din lume
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Where do viruses hide after an epidemic ends? The mystery of the natural reservoir of one of the world's deadliest viruses.
article.articleSummary: Natural reservoirs of deadly viruses remain elusive; animal origins drive spillover. Nipah (Malaysia, 1998) traced to fruit bats; bat-contaminated fruit dropped on pig farms led to pig infections and human cases, with transmission to predominantly non-Muslim Chinese-origin workers; deforestation pushing bats toward orchards emphasized the need to separate pig enclosures from fruit trees. Ebola and related viruses have caused dozens of outbreaks in West and Central Africa over the past 50 years; an ongoing eastern Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak is the second-largest in history, with more than 7,400 cases and over 3,600 deaths. While bats remain a plausible reservoir for Ebola, evidence is lacking and no animal species has been confirmed as the reservoir. Detecting reservoirs relies on sampling apparently healthy animals to detect active virus, guiding prevention and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: 流行が終わった後、ウイルスはどこに隠れるのか？世界で最も致死性の高いウイルスの一つの自然宿主の謎
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はニパウイルス（1998年マレーシア）やエボラウイルスの自然宿主探索に関する科学解説・歴史的回顧記事であり、新規または進行中の感染症イベントの一次報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は科学ジャーナリズム的な解説記事で、ニパウイルスの起源（マレーシア1998年）とエボラウイルスの自然宿主探索についての一般論を扱っている。DRCの『進行中のアウトブレイク』への言及があるが、症例数（7,400例）・死亡数（3,600人）は史実のDRC単独のエボラ流行データと一致しない可能性があり、正確性に疑問がある。新規シグナルとしての価値は低いと判断。マレーシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Flying from UAE today? Emirates, Etihad, flydubai, Air Arabia delays and cancellations as Iran routes halted and Ebola curbs lifted
article.articleSummary: On 27 September 2026, the UAE lifted Ebola-related entry and visa restrictions on Ugandan travellers after Uganda completed the required monitoring period. Restrictions on travellers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and South Sudan remain in place due to the ongoing epidemiological situation; the measures were introduced on 6 June 2026. The update accompanies ongoing travel disruptions at UAE airports, with Emirates and Etihad continuing to operate while Flydubai and Air Arabia report cancellations and delays on several regional routes. Passengers are advised to check their airline and airport updates before travel and allow extra time at the airport. The article situates Ebola as a continuing consideration for regional travel, contrasting Uganda’s lifted restrictions with the ongoing restrictions affecting other neighbouring countries.

triage.headline_ja: 本日UAEから出発？エミレーツ航空、エティハド航空、フライドバイ、エアアラビアで遅延・欠航—イラン路線停止とエボラ規制解除
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱に関連したUAEの入国制限がDRC・南スーダンからの渡航者に対して継続しており、深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念（重症疾患）と渡航制限の2つのIHR基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は主にUAE航空会社の運航状況に関する内容で、エボラは既存の渡航制限の文脈として言及されている。ウガンダへの規制は監視期間終了により解除されたが、DRCと南スーダンへの規制は継続中。新規の疫学的情報（症例数・死亡者数等）は本記事には含まれない。ウガンダ・スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Athorities Issue Dengue Alert For Arunachal's Itanagar As Fever Cases Rise
article.articleSummary: Itanagar region in Arunachal Pradesh issues a dengue alert as fever cases rise. The Itanagar Capital Region district medical officer, Dr C Lowang Mallo, issued a health advisory urging early detection and public awareness. Dengue is a vector-borne illness causing acute febrile illness typically lasting two to seven days. Common symptoms include headache, body ache, joint pain, rashes, and retro-orbital pain. Preventive steps include eliminating stagnant water, regularly cleaning water coolers and tanks, keeping water storage covered, using mosquito repellents and nets, installing window screens, and wearing full-sleeved clothing. Those with dengue symptoms should seek medical care promptly and avoid self-medication; do not take aspirin, ibuprofen, or steroids without medical advice. The advisory notes a fever uptick in Itanagar and emphasizes prevention over laboratory-confirmed case counts.

triage.headline_ja: アルナーチャル・プラデーシュ州イタナガルで発熱症例増加によりデング熱警報発令
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は当該地域では流行性疾患であり突発的異常性は低いが、発熱症例増加を受けた公衆衛生警報が出ており、確定症例数など詳細情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 検査確認症例数の記載はなく、発熱症例の増加に基づく予防的警報。地域限定的な季節性デング熱対応であり、地方当局のみで対応可能とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: UE alocă 252 de milioane de euro pentru sprijin de urgență în zonele afectate de război, epidemii și dezastre. Anunțul Ursulei von der Leyen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: EU allocates €252 million for emergency aid in areas affected by war, epidemics and disasters. Ursula von der Leyen's announcement.
article.articleSummary: EU announces 710 million euros in emergency aid to assist people affected by wars, epidemics, displacements, and disasters, with focus on Africa and nearby regions. Ursula von der Leyen disclosed at the UN General Assembly in New York that about 380 million euros will support Sub-Saharan Africa, targeting migrant protection and voluntary reintegration; a further 252 million euros will provide emergency assistance to communities impacted by conflicts, displacements, epidemics, and natural disasters. Distribution includes 97 million to Sub-Saharan Africa, 103 million to the Palestinian territories and Lebanon, and 52 million to Ukraine, aimed at winter preparedness. Smaller amounts will back stability efforts in the Great Lakes region and aid the Democratic Republic of Congo in combating the Ebola outbreak in the east. The package underscores ongoing responses to war, extreme weather, and epidemics.

triage.headline_ja: EUが戦争・疫病・災害の影響を受けた地域への緊急援助として2億5200万ユーロを拠出。フォン・デア・ライエン欧州委員長が発表
triage.triage_reason: 記事はEUの人道支援資金拠出に関する発表が主題であり、DRCのエボラ流行への言及は既存流行への支援文脈に留まる。新規の感染症学的情報（症例数・拡大状況等）はなく、フルRRAに進む根拠は乏しいが、DRCエボラ流行の継続を示す情報として経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はEUの人道支援資金拠出announcementであり、DRCのエボラ流行はその一部として言及されているのみ。感染症の新規情報（患者数、感染拡大状況など）は記載されていないため、続報の有無を注視する必要がある。他の地域（Lebanon, Ukraine, Palestine等）はエボラとは無関係の支援対象であり、対象国リストにも該当しないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Athorities Issue Dengue Alert For Arunachal Capital As Fever Cases Rise
article.articleSummary: Arunachal Pradesh’s Itanagar Capital Region issued a dengue advisory as fever cases rise. The advisory from district medical officer Dr C Lowang Mallo urges early detection, public awareness, and prompt medical consultation. Dengue is a vector-borne illness causing acute fever lasting 2–7 days, with symptoms such as headache, body aches, joint pain, rashes, and retro-orbital pain. Preventive measures target mosquito breeding, including removing stagnant water, cleaning water coolers and tanks, and keeping water storage covered. Residents should use repellents and nets, install window screens, and wear long sleeves. People with symptoms should seek medical diagnosis promptly and avoid self-medication or taking aspirin, ibuprofen, or steroids without advice. The article provides no laboratory confirmation details, and the alert specifically applies to Arunachal Pradesh’s Itanagar area.

triage.headline_ja: アルナーチャル・プラデーシュ州都でデング熱警報発令、発熱症例増加を受けて
triage.triage_reason: インド・イタナガル地域でデング熱症例増加を受けた注意喚起だが、症例数・重症度・検査確認情報が不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地域医療当局による季節性のデング熱注意喚起であり、具体的な症例数や検査確認情報は記事に含まれていない。毎年発生する蚊媒介感染症の定例的な予防啓発の可能性が高い。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: എച്ച് 1 എൻ 1; ജാഗ്രത വേണമെന്ന് ഡി.എം.ഒ | H1N1; DMO urges caution
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1; DMO urges caution.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 September 2026, Thrissur district reports multiple confirmed H1N1 influenza cases. District Medical Officer in charge Dr. N.A. Sheej urges caution. Individuals with fever, cough, or sore throat should not self-medicate but seek care at health centers. H1N1 spreads via respiratory droplets and by touching contaminated surfaces, with infection possible within about one meter of an infected person. Core symptoms include fever, body aches, sore throat, dry cough, fatigue, and sometimes diarrhea; most recover in 4–5 days, but pneumonia or encephalitis can follow. High-risk groups include children under five, adults over 65, pregnant women, and people with other serious illnesses or weakened immunity. Preventive measures: wear a mask over mouth and nose, avoid spitting, minimize close contact, and do not share mobile phones. After returning home, wash hands with SOPPO hand wash; contacts of patients should undergo testing at nearby facilities.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1;注意を呼びかけるDMO(地区医療officer)
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケララ州で季節性H1N1インフルエンザの複数確定例が報告され当局が注意喚起しているが、重症化や大規模流行の情報はなく、既知の季節性疾患であるため異常性は低い。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして毎年報告される既知の疾患であり、地域当局が予防策を呼びかける通常の公衆衛生対応と考えられる。重症例数や死亡者数などの詳細情報がなく、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: പകർച്ചപ്പനി കൂടുന്നു, നേരിടാൻ നടപടി, മന്ത്രിതല യോഗം ചേരും, ജില്ലാ തലത്തിൽ ഏകോപനസമിതി ഉണ്ടാക്കാൻ നിർദ്ദേശം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The outbreak is increasing; actions to be taken to tackle it; a ministerial-level meeting will be held; recommendation to form a district-level coordination committee.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 September 2026, Kerala is confronting a rising outbreak of dengue fever, influenza, and fifth disease, with about 7,000 fever cases reported daily. In Thiruvananthapuram and northern districts, transmission is increasing, with dengue and influenza cases mounting and fifth disease also on the rise. The Health Department and Local Self-Government Department will coordinate a joint response, with a ministerial-level meeting planned and a district-level coordination committee to be established under district collectors, plus regional committees at local levels. Hotspots will be identified and containment measures implemented. The resurgence comes amid intermittent rains, which may worsen transmission. Medicines are in short supply, and patients are being overwhelmed at government hospitals. The objective is a rapid, integrated response to curb spread through coordinated surveillance, containment, and public health actions.

triage.headline_ja: 流行性発熱が増加、対策を実施へ、閣僚級会議開催、県レベルの調整委員会設置を指示
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州でデング熱・インフルエンザ・伝染性紅斑が急増し、1日約7000件の発熱症例が報告されており、医療体制の逼迫と薬剤不足が生じている。政府が閣僚級会議を招集するなど社会的・行政的関心が高く、フルリスク評価が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 季節性のベクター媒介・呼吸器感染症の同時流行であり、国際的拡大リスクは低いが、医療資源逼迫と行政対応の緊急性から国内公衆衛生上の懸念が高い事例。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases in Cam. Sur hit over 1,200; 18 dead
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Camarines Sur, Philippines, exceed 1,200 with 18 deaths as of 2026-09-27. Gov. Miguel Villafuerte mobilized provincial resources for prevention, surveillance, medical response, hospital preparedness, referral, and immediate action in areas with rising cases. The response prioritizes community-driven vector control: search and destroy mosquito breeding sites, prevent water stagnation, and keep water containers, yards, canals, schools, and workplaces clean. Residents are urged to seek medical care promptly if symptoms such as prolonged fever appear. No details on laboratory confirmation, infection source, or imported/exported cases are provided. The outbreak underscores local public health measures and coordinated action to curb dengue transmission in Camarines Sur, with ongoing vigilance required in affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: カマリネス・スル州のデング熱症例が1,200人を超え、18人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 18人の死亡者を含む1,200件超の症例数という重大な公衆衛生影響があり、州知事による資源動員など行政の関心も高いため、スクリーニング基準（重症度・曝露継続・流行しやすさ）とWPRO基準を満たしフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで季節性・地域流行性の疾患であり、今回の増加は例年の傾向内の可能性があるが、死亡者数と行政の積極的対応から継続的な監視が必要。検査確認や感染源、輸入症例の有無については記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Hơn 34.000 ca sốt xuất huyết tại TP.HCM: Cảnh giác với những dấu hiệu nguy hiểm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 34,000 dengue fever cases in Ho Chi Minh City: Be vigilant for warning signs.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever remains high in Ho Chi Minh City (TP.HCM), with over 34,000 cases year-to-date as the city enters the rainy season that promotes Aedes breeding. In week 38 (Sept 14–20), TP.HCM recorded 1,462 dengue cases, bringing the total to 34,161 by week 38. High-incidence areas include Con Dao, Chanh Phu Hoa ward, and Minh Thanh. Dengue can progress severely in adults, especially those with underlying conditions. Warning signs needing urgent care include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, unusual bleeding, or lethargy. There is no antiviral; treatment centers on rest, rehydration, symptom control, and close monitoring. The Qdenga vaccine, a live attenuated tetravalent vaccine covering DENV-1 to DENV-4, is approved in Vietnam for people aged 4 and older and is administered via Long Chau centers after clinician assessment—complementing, not replacing, vector control. Emphasize early detection and prevention: eliminate breeding sites, protect against bites, and consider vaccination where appropriate.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市でデング熱患者3万4000人超：危険な兆候に警戒を
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はベトナムで季節性かつ流行地域では既知の疾患であり、症例数は多いが国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。地域の流行状況として継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの風土病であり、季節性の増加は例年見られる現象。重症化例や医療体制への負荷は継続監視が必要だが、現時点で国際的な緊急対応の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Arunachal Pradesh issues dengue advisory amid upsurge in short-term fever cases
article.articleSummary: Arunachal Pradesh issued a dengue advisory on Sep 27, 2026, as Itanagar Capital Region reports an upsurge in short-term fever cases. District medical officer Dr C Lowang Mallo urged early detection and public awareness, with preventive steps to curb mosquito breeding: eliminate stagnant water, regularly clean water coolers and tanks, keep containers covered, use mosquito repellents and nets, install window screens, and wear full-sleeved clothing. People with dengue symptoms should seek medical care promptly and avoid self-medication; avoid aspirin, ibuprofen and steroids without medical advice. Dengue typically causes acute fever lasting 2–7 days, with headache, body/joint pains, rashes and retro-orbital pain. The advisory underscores Northeast vulnerability to vector-borne diseases; monsoon rains, waterlogging, unplanned urbanisation, and habitat factors promote breeding. Stronger surveillance and region-specific strategies were urged.

triage.headline_ja: アルナーチャル・プラデーシュ州、短期発熱症例の増加を受けデング熱に関する注意喚起を発令
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の季節的な注意喚起であり、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内で、深刻な公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング熱注意喚起であり、モンスーン期の蚊媒介感染症対策の一環。具体的な感染者数・死亡者数の記載はなく、通常の公衆衛生活動の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് പകർച്ചപനി പടർന്നുപിടിക്കുന്നു. പ്രതിരോധ പ്രവർത്തനങ്ങൾ ഊർജ്ജിതമാക്കി ആരോ​ഗ്യവകുപ്പ്. ഹോട്ട്സ്പോട്ടുകൾ കണ്ടെത്തി പ്രതിരോധിക്കാൻ നിർദ്ദേശം. പനി പടർന്നുപിടിക്കുന്നത് വടക്കൻ ജില്ലകളിൽ.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Contagious fever spreading across the state. Health Department intensifies preventive measures. Hotspots identified to prevent spread. Fever spreading in the northern districts.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 September 2026, a contagious fever is spreading across the state with rising dengue and influenza cases and identified hotspots for containment. The health department, with local authorities, plans joint preventive measures and will form a coordination committee led by district collectors, with committees at local levels. Dengue cases are increasing, influenza infections are reported, and there is an uptick in the fifth fever outbreak. The northern districts are more affected. Intermittent rains may sustain transmission. About 7,000 people seek fever treatment daily; medicines are in short supply and government hospitals are reportedly overwhelmed. Urgent actions are urged, including ministerial meetings and cross-department coordination to accelerate containment.

triage.headline_ja: 州内で感染性の熱病が拡大。保健局が予防対策を強化。ホットスポットを特定し防止策を指示。北部県で熱病が拡大中。
triage.triage_reason: デング熱とインフルエンザの症例が急増し、病院が対応に追われ医薬品不足も発生。政府が緊急対応（調整委員会設置、閣僚級会議）を進めており、社会的・行政的関心が高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング熱・インフルエンザの併発流行で、ケララ州（特に北部県）に限定されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないが、医療リソース逼迫（1日7000人受診、医薬品不足）と行政の緊急対応から地域内での重大なシグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: 拒嫁HIV亲戚被报复　她遭男方注射感染血液 | 中國報 China Press
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Refusing to marry an HIV-positive relative leads to retaliation as she was injected with HIV-infected blood by the groom's side.
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad, central India: Ramani, whose arranged marriage to her HIV-positive male relative Manohar was canceled after he tested HIV-positive in September 2025, was attacked on March 11, 2026 when he forcibly injected his HIV-infected blood into her, transmitting HIV. Manohar was arrested soon after. On April 10, 2026, Ramani died by suicide at home after enduring extreme psychological stress, fear, social stigma, and emotional trauma. The case highlights violence linked to HIV status and stigma in India, with Manohar’s infection confirmed prior to the assault and no indication of a broader outbreak. The incident underscores the need for protection against coercive infection and HIV-related stigma.

triage.headline_ja: HIV陽性の親戚との結婚を拒否した女性が報復として男性側にHIV感染血液を注射される
triage.triage_reason: 個別の犯罪事件であり、公衆衛生上の広範な脅威やアウトブレイクの兆候は認められない。単一事例で感染拡大リスクなし。
triage.notes: 本件は個人間の犯罪事件（強制的なHIV感染血液注射）であり、感染症のアウトブレイクやクラスター形成の兆候はない。HIVスティグマに関連した暴力事件として社会的関心は高いが、公衆衛生上のリスク評価対象としては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة وفيات "إيبولا" في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 3833 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 3,833.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to drive a high fatality burden. The DRC Ministry of Health reports that as of 24 September 2026, Ebola has caused 3,833 deaths among 7,946 confirmed infections, yielding a case fatality rate of 48.2%. These official numbers reflect ongoing outbreak activity in the country, with nearly half of confirmed cases resulting in death. The report provides counts of confirmed infections and deaths but does not include regional breakdowns, symptom details, laboratory confirmation methods, transmission sources, or information on imported or exported cases. The update highlights the severity of the outbreak in the DRC and the ongoing need for surveillance, public health measures, and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の死者数が3,833人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による大規模な死者数（3,833人、致死率48.2%）が継続的に報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 致死率48.2%という高い数値と感染者数の継続的増加は既知のエボラ流行の継続を示す。地域内訳や感染経路等の詳細情報は不明のため、続報でのフォローが必要。

article.articleHeadline: 추석 연휴에 동남아 다녀와 열 난다? "뎅기열 검사 받으세요"-사회ㅣ한국일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever after returning from Southeast Asia during the Chuseok holiday? "Please get a dengue fever test" - Society | Hankook Ilbo
article.articleSummary: KDCA analysis of overseas dengue fever laboratory testing (2020–2025) shows 2,904 tests requested nationwide, with 613 positives (21.1%). Early pandemic years yielded few positives (39 positives, 6.4%); 2021 had only 3. From 2022, as international travel resumed, testing and confirmed infections rose: 2021 69 tests; 2022 338; 2023 632; 2024 900; 2025 757; positives: 2022 98; 2023 177; 2024 177; 2025 122. Among 568 cases with identifiable travel origins, 487 (85.7%) were infected after visiting Southeast Asia. Indonesia accounted for 124 cases (21.8%), the Philippines 110 (19.4%), Vietnam 110 (19.4%), and Thailand 71 (12.5%); together these four countries explain 73.1% of imported infections. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; typical symptoms include high fever, headache, myalgia, arthralgia, and rash; about 75% are asymptomatic. Korea has no indigenous dengue, but imported cases are monitored as a Class 3 communicable disease. Travelers to Southeast Asia should wear long sleeves, use repellents, and seek testing if fever or related symptoms arise within two weeks of return, reporting travel history to clinicians.

triage.headline_ja: 추석 연휴에 동남아 다녀와 열 난다? "뎅기열 검사 받으세요" - 한국일보 (추석連休で東南アジアから帰国後に発熱？「デング熱検査を受けてください」)
triage.triage_reason: 韓国国内での輸入デング熱症例に関する統計・啓発記事であり、新規の異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 本記事は韓国疾病管理庁（KDCA）による2020-2025年の海外由来デング熱検査統計の分析であり、東南アジア（インドネシア・フィリピン・ベトナム・タイ）は感染源国として言及されているが、これらの国自体での新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を報じるものではない。韓国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。
